cn: 奎因和科尔顿早期的感情争执不断，但甜蜜的时刻同样令人难以忘怀。

en: Quinn often misses her mother, but most of all she misses someone to care for her after a long day.

en: Back at school, Harrison often nervously struggled to find the words to tell Quinn that he liked her.

奎因可爱而又永远充满好奇的女儿。

en: Since she was very young, Olivia has been high-spirited and full of curiosity. Her obsession with space travel is just the latest in a long line of interests, including plushies, video games and coloring. Despite the conflict between her parents, she's full of optimism about the future, and one day hopes to explore the galaxy.
cn: 奥利维亚从很小的时候就活力满满，充满好奇。她对太空旅行的痴迷只是她对毛绒玩具、电子游戏和填色游戏等众多兴趣中最新的一个。尽管父母之间存在矛盾，但她对未来充满乐观，希望有一天能够探索银河系。
浪尾岛最受欢迎的业余侦探和餐厅老板。

en: Mother of Olivia, ex-wife of Colton, friend to many
cn: 奥利维亚的母亲，科尔顿的前妻，许多人的朋友

en: As Brimwave's preeminent local sleuth, Quinn has found herself at the centre of many mysteries over the years, but at heart, she's a passionate chef. A few years ago, with help from her family friend, Carmen, and her then-husband Colton, she started her dream restaurant. But like all dreams, it had to end eventually.
cn: 作为浪尾岛杰出的本地侦探，近些年来，奎因发现自己被卷入了许多谜团的中心。不过在她内心深处她一直都想做一名厨师。几年前，在朋友卡门和前夫科尔顿的帮助下，她开了一家梦想中的餐厅。但就像所有的梦想一样，结束的一天总会到来 。

en: Quinn's reliable old friend, who's always had a secret crush on her.
cn: 奎因的可靠老朋友，一直暗恋着奎因。

en: Best friend to Quinn and Amala
cn: 奎因和阿玛拉最好的朋友

en: The sea, his boat, his family

As a capable, dutiful young man that happily inherited his family trade from his father, Harrison is dedicated to his family, and to his friends. While his ambitions never took him beyond the island, he's poured a lot of his energy into the community in recent years, and supplies fish to a dozen restaurants around the beachfront. But in truth, he'd almost always prefer to be at sea.
cn: 作为一个能干、有责任心的年轻人，哈里森从父亲那里继承了家族产业，并且非常重视家庭和朋友。虽然他的雄心壮志从未使他走出过岛屿，但近年来他将大量的精力投入到本地社区，并为海滨附近的十几家餐馆供应鱼类。不过事实是，他其实更享受在海上的时光。

cn: 哇哦！这个瓶子里有一些很特别的东西！

en: I think this will help us in the kitchen. Let's see what it is…
cn: 说不定餐厅里用得上。让我们去试试吧……

en: For a limited time, completing orders will give you<color=#ff9fec> double coins!</color>
cn: 在限定时间内，完成订单可以<color=#ff9fec>获得双倍金币。</color>

en: Life is not a problem to be solved, but an experience to be had.
cn: 生活不是一个需要解决的问题，而是一种需要经历的体验。

en: I invented a new word! Plagiarism!
cn: 我发明了一个新词！绕口溜！

en: Join motorway, exit J13, first exit on roundabout, left on Baxter Rd.
cn: 开上高速公路，从J13出口下，然后在巴克斯特路上左转。

en: We finished this bottle on the 12th June 1966.
cn: 我们于1966年6月12日完成了这个漂流瓶。

en: The things that hurt you in the past have made you a better person.
cn: 那些伤害过你的事情使你成为了一个更好的人。

en: The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
Why did you open this bottle!? You let the demon out!
cn: 你为什么要打开这个瓶子！？你把恶魔放出来了！

en: Yogurt (frozen), spaghetti, onions, biscuits, can of black olives.
cn: 酸奶（冰的）、意大利面、洋葱、饼干、黑橄榄罐头。

en: Help! I'm trapped on a desert island with nothing but discs!
cn: 救救我！我被困在了荒岛上，身边只有几个光盘！

en: Forget about the rescue boat. Send more alcohol.
cn: 别再想救援船了。多给我送点酒来。

en: Hi! Want to be friends? Call me on the number below!
cn: 你好！想交个朋友？请拨打以下号码联系我！

en: She isn't just my friend. She's much more to me than that.
cn: 她不只是我的朋友。她对我的意义远超于此。

en: On my way to see my mother. Wish me luck.
cn: 正在去看妈妈的路上。祝我好运吧。

en: To be united by hatred is a fragile alliance at best.
cn: 因仇恨而建立起来的联盟是脆弱的。

en: You are kind. You are smart. You are important.
cn: 你是善良的，智慧的，重要的。

en: Please find me. I'm not sure where I am, and I'm running out of coconuts.
cn: 请来找到我吧。我不知道我在哪里，椰子也快吃完了。

en: Put me back! I liked it better in the water.
cn: 把我放回去吧！ 我更喜欢在水里。

en: To whoever finds this: be happy! After all, you're by the ocean.
cn: 致发现者：要快乐呀！至少你没有被困在海上。

en: Happiness comes from within, not from without.
cn: 幸福来自内心，而不是外在。

en: Curses! Me grog's all gone! Alas, all that's left is this bottle.
cn: 倒霉！我的酒全没了！ 唉，只剩下这一个瓶子了。

en: You are the lucky winner of 4.5 BILLION marks from the East German Bank!
cn: 恭喜！您是1988年第5期体育彩票的特等奖获得者！

en: You know what? Wilson and I have decided to stay on the island.
cn: 你知道吗？我和威尔逊决定留在岛上了。

en: I hope that someone reads this, one day: butts.
cn: 希望有一天有人能看到我的信息。

en: Maybe the sea will bring you back to me.
cn: 也许大海会把你再次带回到我身边。

en: Something secret steers us both. We shall not name it.
cn: 借助这个瓶子，缘分使我们相知。

en: Don't call your ex. I promise, it's never a good idea.
cn: 不要给你的前任打电话。 我保证，这绝不是一个好主意。

en: What greater endeavor exists than that of collaboration?
cn: 还有什么比合作更伟大的努力呢？

en: It's weird how many bottles wash up here, isn't it?
cn: 有这么多的瓶子会漂流到这里，不是很奇怪吗？

en: Hi! We've been trying to reach you about your car's extended warranty.
cn: 您好！我们一直在尝试就您的汽车保险事宜与您联系。

en: Greetings from an ocean liner! Hopefully there are no icebergs.
cn: 来自远洋客轮的问候！希望不会遇上冰山。

en: I'll never tell you face-to-face, but…I'm actually a bird.
cn: 我永远不会当面告诉你，但是……我实际上是一只鸟。

en: To the finder: write your name and the date, then put it back in the ocean!
cn: 致发现者：写下你的名字和日期，然后把瓶子扔回大海！

en: I wish I'd had the chance to say it: I love you.
cn: 真希望我有机会对你说：我爱你。

en: You are the universe experiencing itself.
cn: 你是宇宙正在体验自身的一种体现。

en: Fear leads to anger. Anger leads to hate. Hate leads to suffering.
cn: 恐惧带来愤怒。 愤怒带来仇恨。 仇恨带来痛苦。

en: Help! I’ve been turned into a bottle!
Dear finder, my name is Mary. I am 10 years old and I like ballet.
cn: 亲爱的发现者，我的名字是玛丽。 我今年10岁了，我喜欢芭蕾舞。

en: Mateo, thank you for the wonderful evening. I'm sorry it didn't work out.
cn: 马特奥，感谢你让这个夜晚变得美好。 很抱歉我没有做到。

en: We're no strangers to love. You know the rules and so do I.
cn: 我们对爱并不陌生。 你我都知道它的规则。

en: WANTED: writer of bottle messages. Application form overleaf.
cn: 通缉：该漂流瓶的作者。 申请表见背面。

en: Forward this message to ten people or Bloody Mary will get you.
cn: 将此消息转发给十个人，否则血腥玛丽就会抓到你。

en: Running out of ink. Send pens.
cn: 墨水已经用完了。请送一些笔过来。

en: Did you know wombat poop is cube-shaped?
cn: 你知道袋熊的粪便是方形的吗？

en: Stole the necklace. Fell off the ship. Whoops.
cn: 偷了一串项链。 从船上掉了下来。 哎呀。

en: Dear stranger, I hope you appreciate this token.
cn: 亲爱的陌生人，我希望你能喜欢这个礼物。

en: Hope this is still intact by the time it reaches you!
cn: 希望当它到达您手中时仍然完好无损！

en: Well, it's not like I need this anymore…
cn: 好吧，我不再需要这个了……

en: I trust the sea to deliver this to someone who needs it…
cn: 我相信大海会将它传递给需要它的人......

en: Honestly, I'm amazed I managed to fit this in the bottle.
cn: 老实说，我很惊讶我能把它装进瓶子里。

en: To the finder: surprise! This is for you.
cn: 致发现者：这是给您的一个惊喜。

en: Take this gift, replace it, and pass it on!
cn: 收下这份礼物，换掉它，然后重新丢进大海！

en: This isn't much use on a desert island, so I consign it to the sea!
cn: 这东西在荒岛上没什么用，所以我把它扔到海里了！

en: Keep this bottle around, and it'll bring you great riches!
cn: 随身携带这个瓶子，它会给你带来巨大的财富！

en: I cast a spell on this bottle! Hopefully it works.
cn: 我对这个瓶子施了魔法！希望它能有用。

en: Careful! This bottle is full of luck. Don't spill it!
cn: 当心！这个瓶子里装满了幸运。别弄洒了！

en: Recycle me! Try using this bottle as a piggy bank.
cn: 试试把这个瓶子当成一个存钱罐。

en: Hope you're having a good day! I pass my good vibes on to you.
cn: 希望您今天过得愉快！我把我的好心情传递给您。

en: Upgrade to this level and activate the VIP Pass to get this reward!
cn: 升级并激活VIP通行证以获得奖励！

en: Purchasing VIP Pass now, you will get:
cn: 现在购买 VIP 通行证，你将获得：

en: The VIP Pass unlocks <color=#1c8ee6>extra perks and prizes.</color>
cn: VIP通行证会提供<color=#1c8ee6>丰厚的额外奖励！</color>

en: Finish orders for the rascally raccoons and earn rewards!
cn: 完成浣熊兄弟的订单并获得奖励！

en: Turn on <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_boostenergy"> to get higher level balloons.
cn: 开启<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_boostenergy">来产生更高等级的气球。

en: Coconut is ready to take flight! Help Coconut gather balloons and he'll get rewards for you! Tap here to see more details!
cn: 小椰子已经准备起飞！帮助小椰子收集气球，他会为你获取奖励！点击此处查看详情。

en: Use Energy to collect Balloons for Coconut! Soar higher for more rewards!
cn: 消耗能量即可为小椰子收集气球！争取飞得更高，获得更多奖励！

en: Coconut will wait for you here during the event. Tap on Coconut to check your progress of his journey again.
cn: 活动期间小椰子会在这里等你。点击小椰子可以再次查看活动进度。

en: Look! An extra balloon appears when you use Energy.
cn: 看，消耗能量时额外生成了一个气球！

en: Tap the info button to get details on the Balloons.
cn: 点击信息按钮查看气球的详情。

en: You can merge Balloons together to make a bigger cluster or you can tap to collect them anytime.
cn: 你可以合并气球来制作更大的气球串，也可以随时点击收集它们。

en: Tony's got a big party planned for some of his friends! And he's gonna need some help!
cn: 托尼计划为朋友们举办一场盛大的派对，他需要一些帮助!

en: Collect event items by tapping on <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_energy"> genarators and finish Tony's orders.
cn: 点击带有<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_energy">符号的母体棋子来获得活动棋子，完成托尼的订单。

en: Collect event items from <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_energy">  generators and finish Tony's orders.
cn: 点击<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_energy">母体棋子获得活动棋子并完成订单！

en: Turn on <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_boostenergy"> to get higher level items!
cn: 开启<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_boostenergy">来获得更高等级的棋子！

en: A token of Tony's appreciation. Enjoy!
cn: 这是托尼的一点心意，快收下吧！

en: Thanks for your help! Hope you had fun, pal!
cn: 感谢你的帮助！希望你玩得开心，伙计！

en: Tap to go to the main board.
cn: 点击按钮开始收集活动棋子。

en: Ha, now look here. Tap the icon to open the event board!
cn: 嘿，点击这里进入活动面板！

en: See and just finish the orders. I have one ready for you.
cn: 我需要你帮我完成一些订单。

en: And then after you finish these orders, I got a gift for you.
cn: 等你完成这些订单，我就送你一份礼物！

en: Now, just tap to put the items to the event board and start merging!
cn: 点击这里把棋子放到棋盘中，然后就可以合并啦！

en: Upgrade to this level and activate the VIP Pass to get this reward!
cn: 升级并激活VIP通行证以获得奖励！

en: Purchasing VIP Pass now, you will get:
cn: 现在购买 VIP 通行证，你将获得：

cn: VIP通行证会提供<color=#1c8ee6>丰厚的额外奖励！</color>

en: You will spend {0} <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_gem"> to refresh store items. Proceed with purchase?
cn: 你将使用 {0} <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_gem"> 刷新商城当前售卖的棋子，确定吗？

en: The extra inventory is closed. Your items are in the queuing area.
cn: VIP仓库权益已到期关闭。您存放的棋子已放于缓存队列中。

en: Quinn finds out some things never change after high school…
cn: 奎因发现有些东西自高中毕业后就从未改变……

en: Quinn realizes that she may be the drama in her life...
cn: 奎因意识到她自身就是各种事件的中心。

en: Quinn receiving her award in front of her old classmates.
cn: 高中同学聚会上，奎因接受了同学们赐予的”绯闻女王”的头衔。

en: Olivia unexpectedly asks Amala for some advice about her parents…
cn: 奥利维亚忽然向阿玛拉询问有关她父母婚姻的事情……

en: Amala helps Olivia to understand her part in her parents' divorce…
cn: 阿玛拉帮助奥利维亚理解她在父母离婚中的角色……

en: Divorce can be hard on kids – Olivia just wants to play!
cn: 离婚对于孩子们过于沉重——奥利维亚只想玩游戏！

en: Harrison bumps into Sam after an eventful evening...
cn: 在经历了一场尴尬的事件后，哈里森碰到了山姆……

en: Harrison accepts that maybe the fire has burned out...
cn: 哈里森承认他的旧情也许早已不复存在……

en: Harrison catching waves for his adoring fans.
cn: 在崇拜者的目光中，哈里森追逐着巨浪。

en: Maybe there are moon rocks inside…
cn: 也许里面包着一个火箭……

en: A serving tray of one of Quinn's tasty treats.
A crate Harrison uses at the dock.
cn: 哈里森在港口使用过的一个板条箱。

en: Get the gossip on your favorite Brimwave residents!
cn: 了解你最喜欢的浪尾镇居民的绯闻轶事！

en: Merge to reach the next level. Tap to collect <color=#1c8ee6>1</color> XP.
cn: 合并以达到下一个级别。点击收集<color=#1c8ee6>1</color>经验值。

en: Merge to reach the next level. Tap to collect <color=#1c8ee6>3</color> XP.
cn: 合并以达到下一个级别。点击收集<color=#1c8ee6>3</color>经验值。

en: Merge to reach the next level. Tap to collect <color=#1c8ee6>7</color> XP.
cn: 合并以达到下一个级别。点击收集<color=#1c8ee6>7</color>经验值。

en: Merge to reach the next level. Tap to collect <color=#1c8ee6>15</color> XP.
cn: 合并以达到下一个级别。点击收集<color=#1c8ee6>15</color>经验值。

en: Tap to collect <color=#1c8ee6>31</color> coins. This items is at its max level.
Out of fashion, but not out of style.

cn: 一件厚重、叮当作响的财富宣言。
喝酒是一件严肃的事情。

en: For when you absolutely must impress.
cn: 当你需要给人留下深刻印象时佩戴。

en: A mask for the rich to hide behind.
cn: 富人在舞会上使用的面具。

en: A crown fit for a king, or an usurper.
cn: 适合国王或篡位者的王冠。
可能镶满了了偷来的宝石。

en: Come back tomorrow to get the daily collection.
cn: 明天记得来领取每日奖励哦！

en: Time is up! Click the button to restore.
cn: 已到期，点击下方按钮可续约。

en: Give the ghost spooky treats to earn rewards!
cn: 给可爱鬼鬼收集礼物赢得奖励！

en: Find the spooky treats and earn rewards!
cn: 给可爱鬼鬼收集礼物赢得奖励！

en: Not enough <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer">\nCollect it on the main board!
cn: <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer">不足，\n快去主棋盘收集吧！

en: Collect <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer"> by tapping on <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_energy"> generators.
cn: 点击带有<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_energy">符号的母体棋子来获得<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer">。

en: Turn on <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_boostenergy"> to get multiple  <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer">!
cn: 开启 <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_boostenergy"> 能量助力获得加倍的<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer">！

en: The ghost is full with Halloween treats – looks like he's ready to go haunting!
cn: 鬼鬼拿到了所有想要的礼物，看起来他已经准备好去恶作剧了！

en: Oh no! Our ghost friend got more tricks than treats! Better luck next time!
cn: 真遗憾！鬼鬼没有拿到想要的礼物，下次好运吧！
新头像:\n小女巫奥利维亚

en: Olivia is ready for a bewitching Halloween night!
cn: 奥利维亚即将度过一个迷人的万圣节之夜！

en: Congrats! You won the holiday limited avatar!
1. Collect <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer"> by tapping on <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_energy"> generators.
cn: 1.点击<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_energy">母体棋子可能获得<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer">

en: 2. Use <sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer"> to break the stones and uncover treats!
cn: 2.用<sprite="icon_property" name="icon_hammer">敲碎石块寻找藏在下面的礼物！

en: 3. Earn rewards by collecting all the treats!
cn: 3.完成鬼鬼的礼物清单赢得它篮子中的奖励！

en: Hey! Tap this icon to check out a new event!
Hey! Tap this icon to check out a new event!
This friendly ghost has a Halloween wishlist! Help them find items hidden under the stones.
cn: 这是鬼鬼！她有一份万圣节礼物愿望清单！这些礼物就藏在石头下面。

en: Grant the ghost's wishes and they'll give you a reward!
cn: 找到这些礼物满足鬼鬼的愿望，他就会给你奖励！

en: Try using the hammer to break the stone here. Maybe we'll find something the ghost wants!
cn: 用锤子敲碎砖块，这里有鬼鬼想要的礼物吗？

en: Looks like the other half is still stuck! Try hitting it again.
cn: 已经露出一半了，再敲碎这块试试！

en: Spend energy using generators on the main board to collect more hammers!
cn: 在主棋盘使用体力点击母体棋子获得更多锤子！

en: <color=#1c8ee6>Click the button</color> to turn on the Generator Booster!
cn: 现在你可以直接<color=#1c8ee6>点击按钮</color>，切换能量助力倍率了！

en: The higher the Generator Boost rate, <color=#1c8ee6>the more energy it consumes</color>. Get even <color=#1c8ee6>higher level items</color> to merge!Click now to try!
cn: 能量助力倍率越高，<color=#1c8ee6>消耗能量越多</color>，产出的<color=#1c8ee6>棋子等级也会越高</color>哦！点击试试吧！

en: Brimwave's favorite handyman, rock star and sandwich maker!
cn: 浪尾镇最受欢迎的勤杂工、摇滚明星和三明治制作者！

en: Sam Walters is a Brimwave native, but left the island to pursue something greater. After years of traveling and experiencing odd and exciting corners of the world, he returned home. Back on Brimwave, he made a living being a freelance handyman, proclaiming himself the 'Fairy Godfixer'. He eventually settled on working in Quinn’s restaurant, where he still dabbles in odd jobs and finds time to be a local rock star.
cn: 山姆·沃特斯是浪尾镇本地人，曾离开家乡去追寻一些更远大的目标。经过多年的旅行并经历了世界上种种奇怪而令人兴奋的角落之后，他回到了家乡。回到浪尾镇后，他以自由勤杂工为生，自称“修理大神”。最终他决定在奎因的餐厅工作。除了做一些勤杂工的工作外，他还抽出时间成为当地的摇滚明星。

en: Oh, hey there! You need me to fix something?
cn: 噢，嗨，你好！有什么东西需要我修理吗？

en: Hah! Wait till you hear this joke…
cn: 哈！你也来听听这个笑话……

en: Hey! Sup bud, want to chill for a bit?
This day just got SO much better! Thanks coming over!
cn: 能见到你真高兴！感谢来访！

en: I heard Painting, Schmainting is having a sale…
cn: 我听说旁边的五金店正在搞促销……

en: Ugh, I'm craving the Crabby Bagel. Oh yeah…lox spread…
cn: 呃，我很想吃蟹肉贝果。没错……再撒上些熏鲑鱼……

en: I wasn't expecting you this late. Down for a midnight hang?
cn: 没想到这么晚还能见到你。在午夜漫游吗？

en: Ah, a fellow night owl. How's it going?
cn: 啊，一个夜猫子。有什么事吗？

en: Since you're here, how about a late night snack?
cn: 既然来了，吃点夜宵怎么样？

en: Me and Buster are going on a walk! Wanna come?
cn: 我正要和巴斯特去散步！要一起吗？

en: Just in time! I was about to make pancakes.
cn: 真巧！我正准备做煎饼咧。

en: Hey, good morning! Go kick some butt today!
cn: 嗨，早上好！准备大干一场吧！

en: Oh yeah! It's lunch time, let me whip up a sandwich for you.
cn: 哦耶！午餐时间到了，我给你做个三明治吧。

en: Time for a break. I could go for an afternoon pick-me-up.
cn: 是时候休息一下了。我可以来一杯下午茶。

en: You know what would be nice? A nice nap on the beach.
cn: 你知道最惬意的事是什么吗？躺在沙滩上小睡一会儿。

en: Ugh, man – I'm starving. What's for dinner?
cn: 呃，伙计——我要饿死了。晚上吃什么？

en: What a day! Time for a well-deserved chill sesh.
cn: 真是忙碌的一天！是时候好好放松一下了。

en: I was going to catch a show later. Want to come?
cn: 我打算稍后去看一场演出。要一起吗？

en: Fancy meeting you here. How was your day?
cn: 很高兴在这里见到你。你今天过得怎么样？

en: Hey, perfect timing! I just finished dinner.
