en: Hello, drama! Not too long ago, Brimwave’s favorite restaurateur, Quinn Castillo, found herself in a jar of pickles. Her troubles started with her ex-husband, Colton Everett, who apparently gambled all their money away! And then, after a peculiar food poisoning incident at Quinn’s restaurant, he turned up to try and win her back. Drama!
cn: 真是场大戏！就在前不久，浪尾岛最受欢迎的餐厅大厨，也就是奎因·卡斯蒂略，发现她的生活突然变得一团糟。一开始，她的前夫科尔顿·埃弗雷特在赌博时把钱输得精光！紧接着，奎因的餐厅爆出了蹊跷的投毒丑闻，而这个男人竟然还有脸回来，并试图挽回他的前妻。多么精彩的大瓜啊！

en: Luckily, Quinn’s friend Sam – the local handyman – was there to help fix up the ruined restaurant…at least until dashing police officer Mark Yeun showed up. Let’s just say Sam took an immediate interest! Mark came with bad news, though: Colton was the prime suspect in the food poisoning incident.
cn: 幸运的是，奎因的朋友山姆是一名资深的本地工匠，这位慷慨的男士很乐意帮她重建一团糟的餐厅。当帅气潇洒的警官马克·元出现在餐厅时，山姆被他深深地迷住了。不过，马克警官却带来了一个坏消息：有许多证据指向了奎因的前夫科尔顿，他已经成为本次投毒案的头号嫌疑人。

en: Big shock! Quinn was stuck between a rock and a hard place, but kooky old Norman shed some light on the matter. Well, sort of. He shared some riddles about gnomes and unsolicited info about the Skunk Ape (Brimwave’s local cryptid), leaving Quinn with even more questions.
cn: 唉，可怜的奎因完全陷入了进退两难的境地，不过古怪的老头诺曼给她带来了一丝希望（或许吧）。他对奎因透露了“地精”的秘密，又自顾自说起了浪尾岛上的神秘动物臭鼬猿，反而让奎因更加一头雾水了。

en: Colton turned to Quinn for help clearing his name, but Quinn’s biggest question remained: could she trust him?
cn: 科尔顿为了洗清罪名向奎因求助，但奎因纠结到了极点：她还能继续相信这个男人吗？

en: Knock, knock…Quinn’s childhood friend, Harrison Taylor, came to deliver his handsome looks, as well as some fresh fish for the kitchen.
cn: 谁在敲门？哦，是奎因儿时的好友，哈里森·泰勒。他是一名帅气硬朗的渔人，给奎因的餐厅后厨送来了刚打捞上来的鲜鱼。

en: Well-aware of Quinn’s nature, and of the predicament at the restaurant, he guessed Quinn’s grand master plan: she was going to start her own investigation, just like she did as a kid.
cn: 作为从小一同长大的朋友，哈里森深知奎因的性情。结合目前餐厅的惨状，哈里森猜中了奎因的后续计划：她要开始自己调查了，毕竟这女孩从小就有当侦探的潜质。

en: Little Miss Popular had other visitors, though: old family friend Carmen Morello came by, as well as the award-winning bistro owner Lori Lynwood (have you tried her lobster rolls!?).
cn: 绯闻缠身的奎因又迎来了一名访客，这位女士是奎因与她父母的邻居和老朋友。紧接着，知名小酒馆的主人罗莉·林伍德也来了（你吃过她家的龙虾卷吗，真是一绝！）。

en: Determined to leave no stone unturned, Quinn started to doubt those around her and put together a list of suspects.
cn: 奎因决定找出案件所有细节，所以她罗列了一张嫌疑人清单，与她来往密切的人都在上面。

en: The next day, Quinn came across her first clue: a prescription bottle with a ruined label. OMG!!! Maybe that was what was used to poison the food…?
cn: 第二天，奎因偶然发现了第一个线索：那是一张被撕掉标签的处方药。我的天！这不会就是污染食物的元凶吧……？

en: But Norman came again with a sterner warning – he wasn’t joking about gnomes! He urged Quinn to beware of the bigger threat: a group called The Bitter Gnomes. Carmen eased Quinn’s worry, claiming that it was just one of Norman’s crazy old stories. But who was telling the truth?
cn: 就在这时，诺曼又来了，并留下了严肃的警告——所谓“地精”可不是在开玩笑！他力劝奎因，一定要小心来自“愤怒地精”组织的威胁。不过，卡门安抚了奎因，并认为那只是诺曼老头的疯言疯语。究竟谁的观点是正确的呢？

en: As if things couldn’t have gotten more complicated already, Quinn found something else: a hidden compartment in her own restaurant!
cn: 就像是老天爷跟奎因开了个玩笑，奎因查到了一条重要线索，自家餐厅里居然有个无人知晓的隐秘小隔间！

en: After a talk with Sam and his friend Riley Maza – who was there to help with repairs – Quinn concludes that Colton could have been using the compartment to hide secrets…or even money!
cn: 奎因和山姆以及山姆的朋友莱利·马萨进行了一场谈话，后者也是来帮忙重建餐厅的。谈话后，奎因得出了一个结论：那个秘密小隔层应该是科尔顿的手笔，他在那里隐藏了许多秘密，还私藏了不少钱！

en: Anyway, it sounded like Colton was up to no good. And that’s not to mention the fact that Norman also said he saw Colton sneaking around the restaurant after hours. What could he have been up to?
cn: 总之，奎因更加确信科尔顿居心不良。此外，诺曼又提供了一条线索，说科尔顿在打烊后在餐厅周围鬼鬼祟祟地溜达，不知道要干什么。所以，科尔顿当时的目的究竟是？

en: So, what the heck was up with that hidden compartment!? Mark came by and pointed out that it looked like someone had forcefully broken into the compartment…but who would do that?
cn: 真搞不懂这个小隔间究竟是怎么回事！马克前来调查时，发现有人似乎曾经强行闯入了这个小隔间……但谁会这么做呢？

en: But it only got more complicated when it turned out that Cupid had made his way into the restaurant that day, too! Sam arrived late and went head over heels when he saw Mark’s stern but warm brown eyes. Ah, young love.
cn: 不过百忙之中，终于出现了一件喜事，丘比特闯入餐厅并射出了爱之箭。那天，山姆迟到了，却正好遇上了在餐厅侦查的马克警官，他几乎被马克那温柔的棕色眼睛迷得神魂颠倒。唉，年轻人。

en: Meanwhile, Colton was trying his best to prove himself to Quinn – making sure to treat Olivia well, but also butting heads with Harrison, who Quinn decided to award a contract to supply the restaurant with fresh fish.
cn: 同一时刻，科尔顿在竭尽全力向奎因保证他的人品，他说自己一定会照顾好两人的女儿奥利维亚。奎因正准备和哈里森签署海鲜食材供应合同，科尔顿不乐意了，直接强硬地跟哈里森对峙了起来。

en: When Carmen came by, she was able to give some of the history of the hidden compartment: apparently it was there when she owned the restaurant – she used it as a safe. But what was its purpose now? And what could have been stolen from it?
cn: 卡门也来到了餐厅，她给奎因带来了可靠的信息：自从她拥有这家餐厅以来，这小隔间就一直待在这里，卡门一直把它用作安全屋，用来应对意外事件。但它现在又被当作了什么呢？闯入的人又偷走了什么东西？

en: Quinn brought up Norman’s crazy theories about ‘gnomes’ being behind it all, but for some reason Carmen got MAD and left in a tizzy. What was up with THAT?
cn: 奎因对卡门说了诺曼所谓的“地精”，那老头坚持是地精在背后胡作非为，这听起来是不着边际的狂想。卡门听后，直接发了大火，并又急又气地走了。怎么回事啊？

en: Not long after, though, Amala showed up and the focus turned to…boys. To be specific, one boy in particular: Harrison. Apparently, Amala had been waiting for him to ask her out! Who would’ve thought he had the hots for Quinn!?
cn: 没过一会儿，阿玛拉也来了。她的关注点……在男孩身上，准确地说，只在哈里森身上。阿玛拉居然一直等着哈里森主动约她出去！但谁又能想到，哈里森的一颗心都在奎因身上呢！

en: But there wasn’t much time for gossip. Lori arrived with bad news: a little birdy told her Colton was going to be charged for the food poisoning incident! The revelation set Quinn into action, but it turned out Sam had a confession…
cn: 好吧，现在不是八卦的好时候。罗莉带来了坏消息：她打听到，科尔顿马上就要因为投毒案被起诉了！这消息催促着奎因快点做出抉择，不过，山姆听罢，开始了他的坦白……

en: It was Sam who broke into the secret compartment! He was trying to protect Colton’s reputation by hiding his secret: Colton was seeing a therapist.
cn: 闯入隔间的那个人居然是山姆！科尔顿之前找过治疗师，而山姆闯入隔间，将治疗师的名片偷走了。山姆之所以这么做，是为了维护科尔顿的名誉——一旦公众知道科尔顿有过心理问题，舆论定会对他不利！

en: But before Quinn could wonder what that meant, Mark called by to tell her about the toxicology report on her food – it turns out that the food poisoning was caused by some kind of medication! Mark insisted that the cops had enough evidence to charge Colton, and that he’d need to turn himself in…dun-dun-dun!
cn: 还没等奎因反应过来，马克顺道前来，告知了案件的毒素检测报告：食物是被某种药物所污染的！马克坚定地认为警方已经有足够的证据去指控科尔顿，他最好主动自首，否则就要蹲大牢了!

en: Poor Quinn. All that chaos around her, and the pot just kept on boiling! Just as she was trying to come to terms with the news that her ex-hubby was being charged with sabotaging their restaurant, she got an ominous, anonymous warning call…from the Gnomes. They threaten and tease her, then hang up! So rude.
cn: 可怜的奎因掉入了舆论漩涡的中心，而且马上就要被吸入深渊了！前夫即将被警方指控，他马上就要坐实投毒的罪名了，正在这时，她接到了一通匿名的诡异电话，而这通电话……来自地精。他们恐吓并嘲讽了奎因，还不等奎因回应，就挂断了电话。真粗鲁！

en: Norman was able to give a little exposition, though; he told Quinn that the Gnomes were a secret society – the oldest in Brimwave, in fact. But before Norman left, he echoed their warning: the Gnomes are best not provoked.
cn: 幸好，老诺曼出现的很是时候。他说地精其实是浪尾岛上最古老的神秘组织。临走前，诺曼严肃提醒奎因，最好不要试图对抗地精，否则……

en: After a little emotional support from Sam, Harrison visited, and Quinn recruited him as her detective sidekick.
cn: 还好有朋友在身边，山姆提供了充足的情感支持。哈里森也来了，奎因决定和他组成侦探小队，一探究竟。

en: The next day, Quinn was able to get confirmation from Carmen that The Bitter Gnomes were REAL. She urged Quinn not to let the name fool her: they’ve ruined lives and businesses. Carmen gave her yet another warning, but would Quinn listen this time? Take a guess.
cn: 第二天，奎因也得到了来自卡门的消息，地精组织真实存在！卡门极力提醒，不要被地精这可笑的名字骗了，他们破坏力极强，毁掉了无数人的生活、打垮了无数商户的生意。卡门已经警告了奎因数次，但这次，奎因会听劝吗？

en: Officer Mark visited again to deliver some more interesting news: the medication they found was, in fact, intended for pets. It almost seemed like Mark was on Quinn’s side – he even hinted that he knew there were other forces working against them…
cn: 马克警官再次来访，并带来一个有趣的发现。食物中的药品是宠物专用药。这下，马克加入了奎因的阵营，他向奎因暗示，有一股隐形的势力正在与他们作对……

en: Not long later, Colton made a surprise appearance – even though he was supposed to have turned himself in. There were a lot of mixed feelings floating around, so Quinn opted to slow things down and chill with Amala. What a hectic few days, huh!?
cn: 不久后，本该去自首的科尔顿竟突然来到了餐厅。奎因百感交集，幸好有朋友阿玛拉陪着她，因此她选择冷静下来，好好地梳理一切。多么忙碌的日子啊！

en: What do you even do with so many loose ends? Especially when you don’t know who to trust…Quinn was in quite the pickle!
cn: 如果你是奎因，你会怎么做？问题是，你根本不知道该相信谁——奎因就处在这样的困境中！

en: But then some odd news came in: Colton was apparently heading out of town. Naturally, Quinn wondered what had got him skipping town so quickly – and busted out the magnifying glass to start figuring things out.
cn: 但又有一个奇怪的消息传来：人人都知道，科尔顿要出城了。奎因也自然想弄明白科尔顿为什么这么要这么着急地逃跑。所以，她没放过任何一个细节，开始了调查。

en: She started with the town sweetheart: Lori. There was something there…she couldn’t be as sweet as everyone said, right? Lori didn’t take kindly to the accusation that she might have something to do with the poisoning. In the game of business, she said, she competes fairly.
cn: 她首先怀疑的是浪尾岛大美人罗莉。总觉得罗莉有些不对劲……有没有可能，她的甜美善良都只是展示给别人看的？但罗莉对这一怀疑不以为然，她坦荡地表示自己只进行公平的商业竞争，不会做出下药这种事。

en: But she played along with Quinn’s detective game and gave her an alibi: at the time of the food poisoning, she was at Buoy Brew waiting for a ‘friend’ that never showed up.
cn: 即使被怀疑，罗莉还是配合了奎因的调查，并提供了不在场证明：投毒案那天，她在航海家酒吧等着一位老朋友。

en: Poor Lori, huh? No luck with love! It almost sounded like a sob story, but Sam vouched for her – once upon a time, he revealed, he used to play in her bistro’s house band. Sam can’t help but gossip a little: back in the day, Lori had an affair with a younger man – the singer in the band! What a scandal!
cn: 可怜的罗莉，她的爱情之路从不顺利，简直到了闻者落泪的程度。山姆曾经在罗莉的小酒馆中兼职演奏乐队，他能担保罗莉的人品绝没问题。不过山姆忍不住八卦了一下，之前，罗莉和那乐队主唱小伙子有过一段恋情，这对双方都是丑闻。

en: But all the fun and games stopped the next day when Quinn got a rude wake-up call.
cn: 但第二天早晨，奎因受到突如其来的惊吓。这下没时间再八卦别人了。

en: Overnight, someone had left her a creepy porcelain garden gnome on her doorstep! It had an even creepier note pinned to its chest that read “TRUST NO ONE”.
cn: 就在前夜，有人在奎因家门口留下了一个令人毛骨悚然的磁制花园地精！更恐怖的是，它的胸前放着一张纸条，写着“别相信任何人”。

en: As if Quinn was already getting paranoid! But Norman encouraged her to turn the warning on its head and start trusting her friends rather than chasing shadows. First up? Sam, who volunteered an alibi: he was occupied the night of the incident, helping some old bandmates with a show.
cn: 奎因都有点精神崩溃了！还好有诺曼在，智慧的老人鼓励奎因别理会地精的警告，而是去相信自己的朋友们。山姆给出了不在场证明，事发当晚，他正在帮一些乐队的老朋友举办演出。

en: The whole situation had more layers than an onion – or so Sam said – but Quinn was still wondering about Colton. Had he upset a contractor like Sam or Riley by underpaying them? Sam ruled that out, saying that Colton always kept up with that sort of thing.
cn: 现在状况百出，可能性简直多如牛毛——这是山姆的比喻。奎因仍然对前夫的行为感到不解，科尔顿是因为少付工资而惹怒了合同工吗？山姆帮忙排除了这个猜想，科尔顿在职时从未拖欠过工资。

en: Still trying to turn over every stone, Quinn asked Riley where they had been the night of the incident; they said they’d been at the show Sam had been at. Apparently, they were a fan! An anxious, flighty fan, who didn’t stay long enough for Quinn to ask more questions.
cn: 不能放过任何一个细节，奎因又问莱利，事发那天他在做什么。莱利的回答是，他那晚去看了山姆乐队的演出，毕竟他是乐队的狂热粉丝。不过莱利好像有急事，不等奎因问明白就离开了。

en: But Quinn still had a lot more stones to turn over to get to the bottom of things. She had someone more important to eliminate: Harrison.
cn: 奎因还有太多没弄清楚的细节，她的嫌疑人名单上还有一个重要的名字未排除：哈里森。

en: Shovel in hand, Quinn got a call: yet another friendly reminder from the Bitter Gnomes to stop her digging. But as we all know by now, it was going to take a lot more than that to stop this determined detective. Quinn was so determined, in fact, that the previous evening she had confronted Harrison about his alibi. It didn’t go well.
cn: 就在奎因拿着铲子干活的时候，又有一个电话打来了：愤怒地精再次友好地提醒她，停止挖掘一切秘密。但我们都知道，奎因侦探意志坚定，谁也无法阻挡她的脚步。对于投毒案，奎因势必找出真凶，因此前夜，她找哈里森辩论了他的不在场证明，过程不太顺利。

en: Maybe she’d gone a little too hard on him, but his alibi – that he was playing cards at the dock – seemed weak. But Harrison has a habit of being forgiving – the next day, he stopped by to clear the air, and the two apologized to each other. Ain’t that sweet?
cn: 或许奎因有些太严苛了，但哈里森的解释似乎说明不了什么，他说当晚他在码头上打扑克。但哈里森是个宽容的人，第二天，他就来餐厅找奎因澄清说明了，两人都对自己不合适的言辞道了歉。这大概就是爱情吧。

en: Even sweeter – good old Harrison offered to take Olivia out for a trip to the aquarium, allowing Quinn to focus on her suspect list. Carmen was next to clear her name – she said she was running errands for her parents and stopped by to collect the mail from her PO box.
cn: 更让奎因开心的是，大好人哈里森主动带奥利维亚去水族馆玩了，这样一来，奎因就能集中排查嫌疑人了。下一个嫌疑人是卡门，卡门解释道，当晚她在帮父母跑腿，顺便去邮箱里取了信件。

en: It seemed like Quinn’s suspect list was finally narrowing down – but that wasn’t the only source of excitement. After Harrison and Olivia got back from their trip, he finally plucked up the courage to ask Quinn out! Kind of. Sort of. It was unclear.
cn: 看来奎因的嫌疑人列表正在缩减，这并不是唯一的喜事。此外，哈里森带奥利维亚回来之后，他终于鼓起勇气约奎因出去了！似乎，大概是有那种意思吧，但两人都不确定。

en: It was up to Amala to confirm, and she couldn’t have been happier to! It was long past time those two at least TRIED going on a date, right?
cn: 只是不知道阿玛拉会不会难过，但她得知后，居然高兴得不得了！这两人已经太久没约过会了，现在这样多好啊。

en: So that’s what they did! And it went so well that both Quinn and Harrison found themselves asking: why hadn’t they done this earlier? The timing was never quite right, it seems.
cn: 于是，他们就去约会了。这次约会太顺利了，所以奎因和哈里森都开始质疑自己，为什么不早点迈出这一步呢？因为，现在似乎并不是谈情说爱的好时候。

en: Basking in the afterglow of a first date, Quinn was ready to get back on track! She set about arranging for Norman to come give his alibi, and said farewell to Carmen, who announced she was leaving the island for a few days to attend a book tour by her favorite author, Ziva Bates.
cn: 奎因沉浸在约会后的幸福感中，但她也没忘了正事！她正准备去问诺曼的不在场证明。卡门也要离开几天浪尾岛，她要去参加她最喜欢的作家，姬瓦·贝茨的新书发布签售。所以，奎因先和卡门道了别。

en: And then, like clockwork, Norman showed up to spin some more superstitious stories. It turns out he was busy doing just that at the time of the incident – thanks to a special arrangement with the cops to distribute his cryptid pamphlets at the station. And it turns out, in the process of doing so, he had captured some surprising evidence.
cn: 于是，诺曼准时来了，还一并带来了更多迷信的奇幻故事。同时，他也带来了自己的不在场证明，事发当晚，他就是在忙着做这些事——他在警察局附近分发他的奇幻海报和小册子。不过，就在诺曼忙着宣传神奇故事的同时，他也发现了一些令人惊讶的证据。

en: For an author’s photo to accompany his article in the upcoming issue of the Cryprid Hunter’s Journal, Norman had taken a photo of himself outside the station. But his awkward old-man selfie had caught more than just a cheeky Norman. Guess who was in the background! It was Mark…and Harrison! What had they been chatting about on the night of the incident!?
cn: 作为下一期《猎隐者杂志》中文章的作者，诺曼需要将他本人的照片一起放在杂志上，所以他在警局外拍了一张自拍。但这位老年人的自拍太过糟糕，焦点不在他的脸上。猜猜这照片捕捉到什么了！马克……和哈里森！案子发生那晚上，他们在一起聊什么呢？！

en: Eager to get answers, Quinn called on Mark to get the truth, and he didn’t mince words: Harrison lied to her. And to make matters worse, Mark reveals that Harrison was the eyewitness that saw Colton leaving the scene of the crime. A crucial part of the case against him!
cn: 这实在是太奇怪了，奎因立刻叫来了马克。马克也没有隐瞒：哈里森对她说谎了。更糟糕的是，马克说，案发当天，哈里森目睹了科尔顿从犯罪现场匆匆离开，这是对他不利的证据！

en: Grab your popcorn, folks! Quinn confronted Harrison, who didn’t have a leg to stand on as he tried to explain himself. Things got so heated that Sam urged him to leave, and Quinn was left distraught. Played a fool! And guess who was ready to come pick up the pieces? None other than Colton. Spicy.
cn: 大家伙，别入戏到把爆米花撒了！于是奎因就直接找哈里森对峙了，哈里森根本拿不出证据，他也不想再辩解了。山姆说服哈里森先离开，只留下奎因独自心烦意乱。她被耍了！猜猜这时谁回到了奎因身边？当然是科尔顿啦！真是一大盆狗血。

en: In the aftermath of first date/betrayal double feature, Amala rode in on her ‘best friend’ horse to help. But it looked like more work needed to be done to make Quinn feel better about it all.
cn: 奎因经历了刚约会就被背叛的双重打击，阿玛拉快马加鞭赶来，试图开导自己的好友。但似乎好友的安慰也不能让奎因心里好受一点。

en: Colton’s presence didn’t make things much better, either – he set about stepping over the boundaries Quinn had set before. At least Colton was enjoying himself, huh? He and Olivia had some great daddy-daughter time – right up until he found out about Olivia’s day trip with Harrison. Uh-oh.
cn: 科尔顿的出现也没让情况更好一些，他越过了奎因设定的界限，不过科尔顿对此十分开心。你问为什么？因为他终于能和奥利维亚来一段快乐的亲子时光了。啊哦，这份快乐持续的时间不长，他得知了哈里森和奥利维亚的一日游。

en: At least Amala was trying to be helpful – she offered an alibi to lift Quinn’s spirits: she was on a hot date with her long-distance boyfriend, Marcus. Not to be confused with the handsome Officer Mark Yuen.
cn: 阿玛拉提供了她的不在场证明，让奎因好受了一些：阿玛拉那晚和异地恋男友马库斯进行了一场火热的约会。不是那位英俊的马克警官啊！别弄混了！

en: But anyway, with Amala crossed off the list, the lineup of suspects was getting smaller and smaller…
cn: 总之，阿玛拉也可以从嫌疑人列表中排除了，嫌疑人阵容已经越来越小……

en: Colton tried to make amends with Quinn, apologizing and promising that he’d changed. Blah, blah blah. All that sweet talk came to a crashing halt when Harrison arrived. The boys bickered, and a frustrated Quinn told Colton how things were: Harrison was just a friend. Hah, sure, Quinn. The whole thing ended in Colton dropping a love-bomb. Eugh.
cn: 科尔顿试图补偿奎因，都是老一套的说辞，吧啦吧啦了一大堆废话，又是道歉又是保证他一定会改邪归正。所有甜言蜜语在哈里森到来时戛然而止。于是，男孩们开始争吵，彻底失望的奎因向科尔顿坦白，哈里森只是朋友罢了。没错，只是朋友，于是这场戏以科尔顿的热烈求爱拉下帷幕。真是无言以对……

en: The next day, Quinn got another phone call – this time from Dr. Clay, Coconut’s vet. The medicine they’d run out of was back in stock, and an order Colton had made was ready for collection. What the heck? Apparently, someone had bought the entire stock of cat medicine a few weeks back, and it WASN’T Colton.
cn: 第二天，奎因接到了一通电话，是克雷医生打来的，也就是负责给小椰子看病的兽医。医生说之前科尔顿订购的猫咪药品没货了，现在订单可以发货了。什么情况？！显然，有人在几周前买光了猫咪药品，那人显然不是科尔顿。

en: So, who else was buying the medicine that had been found in the food!? Quinn was ready to chase a new lead. She called Mark over to discuss the new information – but not before checking Mark’s alibi. You can never be too sure, right?
cn: 所以，是谁买了那些药品？！它们一定都被偷偷倒在了食物里！奎因准备顺着这个线索搜寻下去，她给马克打电话，叫他一起来分析这个新线索。不过……马克的嫌疑还没被排除。毕竟谁也说不准，不是吗？

en: Apparently, Mark was stood up on a blind date that night. Set up by his co-workers, who think he’s a workaholic!
cn: 还好，马克那天被拉去相亲了。他多管闲事的同事可以作证，因为同事认为马克是个工作狂，所以才组了这个局！

en: Sam took the chance to ask Mark out for coffee, but it turned out Mark’s colleagues might have been right. Maybe after the case is closed, said Mark. Poor Sammy.
cn: 山姆抓住机会，鼓起勇气约马克一起去喝咖啡。不过马克一心全扑在这投毒案上，婉拒了山姆。可怜的山姆，看来马克的同事叫他工作狂也很合理……

en: That evening, Carmen returned from her trip and checked in with Quinn, who filled her in on everything she’d missed. Carmen was happy that things were working out for Quinn but couldn’t help but make another passive comment towards ‘Quinn’s silly meddling’. Things got a little heated between the two, with Carmen reminding Quinn that she should leave the detective work to the police.
cn: 这天晚上，卡门的旅程结束了，回到了浪尾岛。她立马去见了奎因，激动地对奎因说了签售的一切细节。卡门对于案件终于有些眉目感到开心，但同时，她也对奎因的过度干涉有些不满，甚至评价这种干涉是愚蠢的。于是，两人逐渐开始争吵，卡门坚信这件事应该留给警察来管，奎因把自己放在了危险的境地。

en: Little did Carmen know how close Quinn was to proving Colton’s innocence…
cn: 卡门不知道的是，奎因已经能够证明科尔顿是无辜的了……

en: After exploring a rarely used backroom, Quinn granted Sam a permanent office-workshop at the restaurant, but work came to a sudden halt when they found another piece of evidence: another bottle of Coconut’s medicine.
cn: 奎因在餐厅后面找到了一个不怎么用的空房间，她决定装修一下，送给山姆做办公室和工坊两用的永久房间。收拾了一会儿，几人的装修工作紧急终止，因为它们又发现了另外的线索：小椰子的另一瓶药剂。

en: Like a true detective, Quinn made sure no one touched the evidence and made a swift call to get Mark on the scene. It turned out that the room was a veritable treasure trove of clues – and one very important clue was found by Olivia: graffiti on the wall of a gnome signed with the initials ‘R.M.’
cn: 侦探的必修课：不能让任何人碰到证物。因此奎因把药品保护起来，并快速打给马克，让他赶快来到现场。原来，这房间是个线索宝库，奥利维亚还发现了一个极其重要的线索，墙上有个地精图案的涂鸦，旁边写着人名首字母R·M。

en: Once Mark arrived, the whole gang were all pondering who R.M. could be, but no one had any ideas until Sam sadly suggested that it could be his friend: Riley Maza, who would have had access to the restaurant on the night of the incident!
cn: 等马克一到，所有人都开始沉思R·M可能是谁，但全都毫无头绪。这时，山姆难过地提出了一种可能性，有可能是他的好朋友莱利·马萨。他很有可能在事发当晚潜入了餐厅！

en: Mark offers to run fingerprints on the medicine bottle, and they anxiously await the results.
cn: 马克去验证瓶子上的指纹了，大伙在焦虑中静静等待着检验结果。

en: The next day, Quinn came across something peculiar: an origami crane. She was struck by a sentimental reminder of her late mother, who used to make them when Quinn was a kid. Sam suggested that she keep it. I’m not crying, you’re crying!
cn: 第二天，奎因突然发现了个奇特的东西，是一只千纸鹤。奎因已逝的妈妈在奎因小时候会给她折千纸鹤，所以奎因认为这是妈妈给她提示，她短暂地陷入了悲伤之中。山姆安慰了她，并建议奎因一定要留着它。呜呜……我没哭，你才在哭呢！

en: Ahem. But back to the matter at hand: Mark returned with the results on the pill bottle! The fingerprint WAS from Riley.
cn: 呃，言归正传，马克的指纹检测结果出来了！那指纹的确属于莱利。

en: Mark announced that he’d already taken Riley into custody – and in official questioning, the young repair worker had already admitted their involvement in the incident. Result!
cn: 马克宣布，他已经把莱利送进拘留所了，警方正在审问他，这位年轻的修理工终于承认了他的罪行。尘埃落定！

en: But in a peculiar turn of events, Riley was insisting on using their one phone call to contact Quinn and apologize. Quinn accepted the call, and Riley explained why they did it. It was simple: money. Apparently, someone was going to pay Riley a LOT if they pulled off the job.
cn: 审问中途，莱利突然要求警察给他一个手机，他想给奎因打电话进行诚恳的道歉。奎因接起这通电话，听完了莱利所有的解释。他的目的很明确也很简单，只是为了钱。显然，只要莱利接下这份卑鄙的活，就会有人给他一大笔钱。

en: Riley seemed like they wanted to say more, and Quinn guessed that they were hinting at the Gnomes’ involvement – but they were too nervous to talk about it on the phone. Ominous!
cn: 除此之外，莱利没什么要说的了。奎因猜测，莱利想暗示地精组织的存在与介入，但他太紧张了，也不敢在电话里明说。有种不祥的预感……

en: But after that, it was time for celebration! The true culprit had been found! Colton’s name had been cleared!
cn: 不过，先庆祝一下吧！他们找到了真凶，科尔顿的罪名也没有啦！

en: And Lori was asking for…dating advice? Excuse me, what!? It seemed like Harrison and Colton’s vying for Quinn’s attention had spread, and Lori was interested in what Quinn was doing to vex those two men. Confused, Quinn agreed to help Lori in her dilemma.
cn: 罗莉在问……约会建议？什么，我没听错吧？！听起来，哈里森和科尔顿对奎因雄竞这事儿传播挺广的，罗莉也很好奇奎因到底是怎么做到了。奎因虽然疑惑，但也积极给罗莉提出了建议。

en: Just as things were getting light-hearted, Quinn got another mysterious call from the Gnomes; this time, the stranger was congratulating Quinn for closing the case. Apparently, the fun was just getting started.
cn: 就在奎因心中的大石头落地之后，奎因又接到了一通来自地精的电话。通话中，那人向奎因贺喜，恭喜她顺利找出了投毒案的真凶。显然，对方在看笑话，而且地精的阴谋还没结束。

en: But before the Gnomes’ ‘fun’ could begin, Quinn and Amala took the chance for some much-needed spa time. It was time to put away the magnifying glass and get out the cucumber slices!
cn: 但在地精作妖之前，奎因和阿玛拉做了场超棒的深度按摩。有时候，就要放下世间的种种是非，在眼睛上盖两个黄瓜片休息。

en: It was time to relax...at least until the next mystery began.
cn: 休息吧……至少在下件事发生前，美美地放松吧。

en: Ah, the magic of facemasks and cucumber! After a night of TLC, everyone was feeling quite refreshed – that is until a surfer man-child crashed his freakin’ boat into the restaurant!
cn: 面膜和黄瓜真的有魔力！经过一晚上的放松，所有人都感觉焕然一新。但紧接着，这种感觉就被一场意外打破，一名冲浪的男人将他那倒霉的船撞上了餐厅！

en: Welcome to the stage, Vance-Pierce Cunningham – Amala’s cousin (by marriage). Given her luck so far, Quinn quickly became wary of Vance and his "accidental” boat crash. I mean c’mon. We can all see through that façade, right?
cn: 各位，欢迎回来。万斯·皮尔斯·坎宁安就是这场船祸的罪魁祸首，他竟然还是阿玛拉的远房表弟。鉴于奎因一直以来碰到的“好事”，奎因并不认为这是场意外，她快速对万斯和他那倒霉的冲浪船产生了怀疑。对吧？大家都觉得船撞上餐厅这种事太不对劲了吧？

en: Vance was quick to spin a yarn about how he lost control of the boat on his way to see his ‘future wife’, Lori Lynwood. Wait. Lori Lynwood!?
cn: 万斯也很快地开始了他的解释，他说他在见未来妻子的路上，船体一不小心就失控了……等等，他说自己未来的妻子是……罗莉·林伍德？！

en: Cue an eruption of disbelief and confusion. But as quickly as he came, Vance made his exit – luckily on foot rather than by boat. Following her instinct, Quinn called in a favor and requested that Mark do some digging on Vance.
cn: 怀疑的苗头一旦开始，就不会再消失了。但万斯很快就离开了，幸运的是他离开时没开船。奎因给马克打了个电话，劳烦他帮忙查查万斯的资料。

en: But there was more to add to Quinn’s plate; word was spreading that famed author Ziva Bates was headed to Brimwave.
cn: 但奎因要面对的不止这一件事。岛上有传闻，说姬瓦·贝茨就要来到浪尾岛了。

en: The rumor was that Ms. Bates was looking to invest or buy out a restaurant or two. Better watch out, Quinn! But as Quinn contemplated the possibility of Ziva buying her restaurant, Colton showed up – making it very clear that he wasn’t going anywhere.
cn: 传闻称，这位贝茨女士正在准备投资或收购一两家餐厅。奎因，你要警觉起来啊！正当奎因思考姬瓦收购她餐厅的可能性时，科尔顿突然出现，并誓死保证他不会再离开了。

en: A new mystery, and new drama too? It looked like Quinn Castillo had a lot on her plate. Ain’t no rest for the wicked, huh?
cn: 又有一个谜团出现了，或许还有场新的狗血大戏？奎因·卡斯提略还有太多新的事情要做，恶人还没有受到制裁呢，对吧？
第二十二天~第二十三天

en: Something wasn’t adding up for Quinn. How can one woman attract so much drama!?
cn: 奎因真的搞不懂，她怎么能陷入这么多绯闻中？！

en: And to make things just a touch stranger, Vance showed up again…looking for his sunglasses. Best to keep an eye on that one. Quinn tried to get some answers, but Vance stuck to his story – nothing out of the ordinary, except the eerie feeling that he was being followed. What was that about?
cn: 万斯的出现让事情更加奇怪了……他回来找撞船那天遗落在这里的墨镜。奎因知道，她最好对万斯保持警惕，所以再次问他关于船的细节。但万斯的说辞依然没变，那天没什么不寻常的地方，只是，他有种被人跟踪监视的感觉。

en: To lighten the mood, Harrison stopped by to help but Quinn was still on edge about the looming presence of Ziva Bates. What if she really did want to buy the restaurant? Quinn's gears started turning: what if Ziva had something to do with the crash?
cn: 气氛有一丝沉重，于是哈里森也来帮忙开导奎因了，但她仍然为将要到来的姬瓦·贝茨感到不安。如果她真的要收购自己的餐厅呢？奎因的侦探脑瓜飞速转动：姬瓦会不会和这次的撞船事件有关？

en: Later, the one and only Lori Lynwood paid a visit. And it seemed she already knew about Brimwave’s infamous man-child Vance and his involvement in the crash. She was quite aware of his ‘crush’ on her – though she called it a borderline-healthy obsession. She was probably right, too.
cn: 过了一会儿，大美人罗莉·林伍德来拜访了餐厅，她也听说了万斯的著名撞船事迹，似乎人人都知道这男人幼稚任性的性格。万斯是个情种，这一点罗莉早有耳闻，不过她有些避之不及，认为这是一种越界的痴迷。或许吧，她是对的。

en: Quinn couldn’t help but feel the link between Vance and Lori was a little suspicious. What if she was the mastermind behind the crash?
cn: 奎因对这段孽缘也无能为力，但她感觉万斯和罗莉的关系还没有这么简单。罗莉她……会不会也是嫌疑人呢？

en: The next day Quinn got a very concerning call from some nosy lawyers about her property. But they were keeping the identity of their client hush-hush. Who could it possibly be?
cn: 第二天，多管闲事的律师给她打了个电话，试图干涉奎因的餐厅地产，奎因对此自然是有些焦虑的。更糟的是，他们不能说出是谁在背后指使。到底是谁在窥视奎因的餐厅？

en: Following the call, Quinn got news that Ziva had approached Lori about her bistro…but did that mean Quinn was in the clear? It couldn’t possibly be that easy…right?
cn: 紧接着，奎因得到小道消息，姬瓦已经和罗莉沟通了小酒馆收购一事……这是否代表奎因的餐厅暂时安全了呢？不过，事情不会这么快就结束吧……

en: Meanwhile, Colton and Harrison were keeping the tension at the restaurant nice and tight with constant bickering. Ugh, boys. Harrison even had the nerve to ask Quinn out to see a movie in front of Colton. Way to go, Harrison…
cn: 这时，科尔顿和哈里森还在对峙，搞得餐厅氛围非常紧张。唉，男人是这样的。哈里森还在科尔顿面前约奎因出去看电影，祝他成功吧……

en: Quinn started to wonder if Harrison had an ulterior motive. Was he really just the fish-man next door?
cn: 奎因震惊，她都开始怀疑哈里森并不是表面上的邻家渔夫男孩了，这男人的确别有用心。

en: It was almost a mercy when Mark returned with an update about Vance. He’d managed to pull him in for questioning, but Vance had stuck with his story. He just lost control of the boat – no funny business…or so he said.
cn: 幸运的是，马克带来了万斯的消息。马克本来想严厉审问一下，但万斯仍然坚持他的那套说辞：只是船突然失灵了而已，此外没有任何奇怪的地方。

en: But Quinn wasn’t giving up on the theory that someone had put him up to it. Who had it out for her the most? Was it Ziva? Lori? Or could it have been Harrison…?
cn: 但奎因还是没有放弃自己的怀疑，或许是有人指使万斯呢？谁天天盯着奎因，不让她好过？姬瓦？罗莉？有没有可能是哈里森？
第二十四天~第二十五天

en: Quinn began to wonder if the whole boat fiasco had something to do with Colton…just like last time. Speaking of: guess who stopped by with some fancy jewelry for Quinn? Maybe he thought he could buy her affection.
cn: 奎因开始怀疑科尔顿和撞船事件有关……不能排除任何人的嫌疑。哦等一下，猜猜谁又来了，还给奎因带来了一些精致的珠宝？没错，是科尔顿。他大概觉得自己能买回奎因的心吧。

en: Whatever the reason for Colton’s kindness, the new bling was overshadowed by the sudden appearance of a certified drama queen – a blond baddie that would LOVE to speak to the manager.
cn: 不过科尔顿现在不是主角了，舞台灯光聚焦在了一位突然出现在餐厅里的小姐，她一头金发，看起来像是个刻薄的坏人，能制造出很多绯闻的那种。此刻，她正趾高气昂地要见餐厅经理。

en: Who was she? None other than Colton’s crazy ex-girlfriend, Sophia Roberts – who just so happened to be in Brimwave on ‘business’…though she was very cagey about what that business actually entailed.
cn: 除了索菲娅·罗伯特还能是谁呢，科尔顿的这位疯狂前女友就这么“恰好”来浪尾岛谈生意了。不过，她对这个业务还是比较谨慎的。

en: After that, Carmen came by with some exciting news: Ziva had announced a new novel! Breakout your bookmarks, people! And the main character was going to be a cellist, just like Carmen…wasn't that happy coincidence?
cn: 不久后，卡门也带来了一个激动人心的消息：姬瓦的新书要出版了！这本书的主角会成长为一名大提琴手，而卡门曾经也演奏大提琴……真是个令人兴奋的巧合！

en: But then Vance crashed Carmen’s visit and…offered to help Quinn with renovations? He’s an odd one. Carmen warned that she’d keep a close eye on him, but Vance was too busy showing off his muscles to notice.
cn: 不过，万斯打断了卡门滔滔不绝的分享。他提出……愿意帮奎因重建餐厅？真是个奇怪的人。卡门警告万斯，说她会一直盯着他的，但万斯忙着秀肌肉，完全没注意卡门说了什么。

en: Lori arrived just in time to get a look at Vance’s gun-show, but she wasn’t impressed – and decided it was finally time to explain their weird relationship.
cn: 罗莉也来了，正巧碰上了万斯的猛男秀。但罗莉完全没有被那壮硕的肌肉吸引，反而认为这是澄清两人关系的好时机。

en: Vance helps out, showing off his shredded muscles, Lori comes by. Finally, someone’s here to properly explain their relationship.
cn: 幼稚的大男孩万斯、迷人的罗莉都在餐厅了，众人好奇心爆棚，都在等着罗莉解释他们之间的关系。

en: It turns out that Vance was once Lori’s water-skiing instructor, and Lori was his best student. Teacher’s pet, apparently. It was love at first sight…for Vance, at least – which made this a very peculiar love story.
cn: 其实，万斯曾经是罗莉的水上运动教练，而罗莉也是他教过的学生里最有天赋的那个。同时，罗莉也是个听话的学生。万斯坦白，第一眼见到罗莉，他就坠入爱河了，而罗莉对他却没有意思。所以，两人之间只是奇特的单方面恋情。

en: Lori only became more entangled in the web of connections after she revealed that she had worked with Sophia in the past – and that Sophia was now working for Ziva! That quickly made Sophia an addition to Quinn’s suspect list. And to make matters worse, Lori also let slip that Vance had been asking her odd questions about Quinn’s restaurant.
cn: 罗莉透露，索菲娅曾经与她合作过一段时间，正因如此，她才陷入了复杂的人际关系之中。而那个索菲娅现在又成了姬瓦的小跟班！于是，奎因快速把索菲娅的名字列在了嫌疑人清单上。罗莉还透露，万斯向她打听过奎因的餐厅，问的都是很奇怪的问题。

en: But over brunch the next day, Lori dismissed the idea that Vance was the true threat – there had to be someone else pulling the strings of this Vance marionette.
cn: 但在第二天早上，罗莉排除了万斯的嫌疑，一定是背后有人指使他，万斯本人不过是一枚棋子罢了。

en: And then – speaking of suspicious people – Colton showed up to start the latest battle. Naturally, Quinn suggests that he had something to do with Sophia’s random arrival on the scene – but he claimed he had nothing to do with it. He didn’t even know she was on the island…or so he said.
cn: 说到嫌疑人，科尔顿又来了，并开启他的求爱大作战。他坚称自己与索菲娅绝无任何联系，也不知道为什么她会来到浪尾岛。科尔顿极力和索菲娅撇开关系，说他都不知道索菲娅上岛了……反正就是这些话。

en: It turned out to be Amala that came in clutch with some info about Sophia. She’d been doing some digging, and had discovered that Sophia had made it big as an influencer – mostly from writing reviews and promos on her fairly popular blog.
cn: 阿玛拉带着有关索菲娅的消息来了，她一直都在挖掘这位金发女郎的消息。阿玛拉发现索菲娅是个大网红，会在博客平台上晒一些宣传和评论，而且非常受欢迎。

en: And what was the latest article on her blog? Well, it was about dear old Quinn, of course. Sophia didn’t much like her, or the restaurant. Quinn added her to the suspect list with extreme prejudice.
cn: 猜猜索菲娅发的最新博客是什么？好吧，当然和奎因有关。看来索菲娅不太喜欢奎因的餐厅与餐厅主人。总之，现在奎因对她充满了偏见，狠狠地把索菲娅加到了嫌疑人名单上。
第二十六天~第二十八天

en: Dubbing him ‘Vance the Flex’ after he made another surprise appearance, Quinn found herself drawn into Vance’s favorite topic of discussion: Lori. Quinn wanted to know why he’d been talking to Lori about her, and Vance claimed it was just an excuse to talk to her at all. What a weird guy.
cn: 万斯再一次来到餐厅时，奎因戏称他为“骄傲的万斯”。万斯对有关罗莉的话题滔滔不绝，而奎因竟然也听入迷了。不过，奎因有点奇怪，为什么万斯要问罗莉关于餐厅的问题呢？万斯解释道，因为只有这样，他才能和罗莉说上话。真是个奇怪的男人。

en: But what’s this? Good news!? What a turn of events! Sophia’s article actually turned out to be a good thing – it got people talking about Quinn’s restaurant. And any publicity is good publicity, right? Take that, Sophia!
cn: 同时，好消息也突然来了，猜猜是什么？索菲娅的差评文章反而起到了宣传作用，大家都很好奇，因此纷纷讨论起奎因的餐厅。哪怕是负面宣传，也能起到正面的效果，索菲娅，没想到吧！

en: Still, Quinn wanted to know what her deal was, and took time to talk to her woman-to-woman. She finds out that Sophia arrived AFTER the boat crash.
cn: 尽管如此，奎因还是好奇索菲娅在打什么算盘，于是，两人进行了一场女人之间的对话。索菲娅声称，她是在撞船之后才抵达岛上，并且她有机票作为不在场证明。

en: And thinking about it, it didn't seem like Sophia’s style – so Quinn crossed her off her list. But what about her employer, Ziva Bates? Quinn did a little digging and discovered that Ziva had a little history with Lori. A while back, Ziva had presented Lori with the award for ‘Best Bistro’. Maybe that was her way in…
cn: 仔细想想，在背后动手脚不像是索菲娅的风格，所以奎因把她从名单上划掉了。但她的老板姬瓦·贝茨呢？奎因在调查中发现，曾经姬瓦和罗莉有一些接触，不久之前，姬瓦给罗莉颁发了“最佳小酒馆奖”，或许，这就是姬瓦阴谋的开始……

en: The next day, the original dream team were back at it again! But hold on – Mark had given himself a massive papercut at the office, which worried sweet little Sam.
cn: 第二天，奎因的老朋友们都来了。哦，马克的手在办公室里被纸割伤了，可把山姆给心疼坏了。

en: Sam fussed over him, but before long, the trio were done dillydallying. Quinn decided to take the next step on her investigative adventure, and contacted Brimwave’s harbormaster, Lloyd Halpern – an old friend of her father’s, and the expert on all goings-on down at the docks.
cn: 山姆对马克的伤口反应很大，但这三位很快就把注意力放到了正事上。奎因决定继续她的调查，所以她联系了劳埃德·哈尔博，浪尾岛的码头管理者，同时也是奎因父亲的老朋友，他对码头发生的一切了如指掌。

en: Lloyd gave her a big breakthrough: apparently, someone was fiddling with Vance’s boat a few nights ago. But who could that have been? Was it someone sabotaging his boat?
cn: 劳埃德给了她一个重要线索：几天前，有人动过万斯的船。但谁能对冲浪船做手脚呢？那人是要故意破坏万斯的船吗？

en: It looked like Quinn was finally getting somewhere with her case – she even decided to cross Colton off her suspect list, even though it seemed like he was guilt-tripping her into doing it. Supposedly, he’s been the model ex-husband. Why would he ever want to ruin Quinn and the business they built together?
cn: 看来，撞船案终于得到了一些进展。科尔有点故意装委屈的意思，让奎因心软，于是奎因把他从嫌疑人名单中划掉了。这么看来，科尔顿或许是一名模范前夫，早知有今日，当初又何必要背叛奎因，毁掉了两人的心血生意呢？

en: Anyway – never mind him. Quinn had arranged, via Lori, to have a face-to-face meeting with Ziva the next day. It was the moment everyone had been waiting for – and tension was high as she revealed whose restaurant she wanted to invest in.
cn: 算了，先别管科尔顿了。奎因通过罗莉和姬瓦约了一场面对面谈判会。所有人都在等这个，他们很关心姬瓦究竟要投资谁的餐厅。

en: Ziva showed Quinn a check with a number on it so big that her eyes went wide. She hadn’t seen a number that big since math class! Ziva offered a deal: she’d let Quinn stay on as manager so long as she got to call the shots. Wasn’t Quinn lucky?
cn: 姬瓦甩出一张支票，奎因从来没见过这么一长串数字，她的眼睛都瞪大了！这位阔气的女士提出一个交易：奎因还可以做餐厅经理，但要由姬瓦自己掌控大局、发号施令。奎因这算是赚了吗？

en: Ziva gave Quinn some time to think things through, but after some class-A meddling from Sophia, Colton made a choice: he was going to leave – for real this time – to take some time for himself. Emotional maturity from Cole? Whoa, didn’t see that coming.
cn: 姬瓦让奎因好好思考一下。不过，在索菲娅不厌其烦的骚扰后，科尔顿做出了一个决定：他要离开了，这次是真的要离开了，他要给奎因和自己一点时间，去冷静下来好好思考。看起来，科尔顿似乎成熟了一些？哇，真没想到事情的走向是这样的。

en: Not long after, Quinn got ANOTHER curveball. Carmen showed up to encourage her to sell the restaurant. Having Carmen’s blessing was a big deal, but could Quinn really part with the restaurant? It did seem to be a hotspot for bad luck, after all.
cn: 不久后，奎因又迎来了一个突发事件。卡门专门过来，支持奎因卖掉餐厅。得到卡门的支持和祝福是一件值得高兴的事，但奎因真的准备好卖出自己的心血了么？毕竟，谁也不知道收购之后会发生什么，对吧？

en: The day ended with a visit from an unhappy Lori. Ziva had offered to buy her bistro as well. Weird, right? She up to something, but Lori and Quinn were quickly hatching up a plan…what if they joined forces?
cn: 这天晚上，罗莉前来拜访奎因，她看起来不太开心。姬瓦也想出资收购她的小酒馆。听起来真奇怪啊，不是吗？姬瓦肯定有什么别的目的，但奎因和罗莉快速制定了计划，这两位联手，可不知道会发生什么……

en: Then, maybe they’d have an upper hand against Ziva. Watch out, Ziva, an unlikely pair have just entered the game…
cn: 她们或许能和姬瓦一决高下。小心行事吧，姬瓦，你可能惹了不该惹的人……

en: Can we say ‘fangirl’!? Ziva was officially in town, and Carmen was set on going to the latest stop on her book tour. But before Carmen set off, Quinn had a chance to see the book that was entrancing her. Well, isn’t this a coincidence? Ziva’s novel involves someone crashing a boat…just like Vance did.
cn: 姬瓦要正式进城了，这是她的最后一场新书发布签售会，卡门也要跟随偶像的步伐，真是个迷妹！卡门出发之前，奎因终于有了点空闲时间，于是她看了姬瓦的新书。书中，有一个角色开船出了事故，把船撞入了店铺……和万斯的行为一模一样，这真的是巧合么？

en: The timing was impeccable. Quinn brought up her suspicions to Carmen, but that just led to another heated row between them. Carmen proclaimed that she’d had enough of Quinn’s detective nonsense and left Quinn in the dust of a ruined morning.
cn: 这实在是太可疑了，奎因向卡门表示她怀疑姬瓦，于是两人再次产生了嫌隙。卡门表示，她真的受够了奎因自以为是的侦探行为。于是卡门夺门而出，没有再理会奎因。

en: As if that wasn’t enough, Quinn got another blow to the gut right after. Sam arrived with a postcard from her father, Dominic Castillo – who had been away for years, and barely ever wrote back home. Dominic and Quinn didn’t have the best relationship, so all Quinn wanted to do was brush it under the rug.
cn: 老天爷好像嫌奎因的生活还不够乱，再次跟她开了个玩笑。山姆带来了给奎因带来她父亲多米尼克的明信片，他多年前就离开了浪尾岛，也从来没给家里写过信。多米尼克和奎因的关系并不好，所以，奎因现在只想把这明信片藏到看不到的位置。

en: But all that had to take a backseat anyway, because Ziva called by to check in on her potential future investment. Quinn was yet to make a decision on selling the restaurant to someone that gave off such creepy villain vibes. Seriously – ‘shady’ is written all over Ziva. She left but gave Quinn two days to make a choice.
cn: 不过，现在更要紧的事不是这个。姬瓦又来催促奎因了，询问了关于餐厅与奎因投资意向的问题。其实奎因还完全没下定决心，她不知道把餐厅卖给姬瓦会发生什么，并且她认为姬瓦身上有种可怕的卑鄙感，说真的，“阴暗”这个词简直就是为姬瓦量身打造的。于是姬瓦给了奎因两天思考时间，便离开了。

en: Ah, yes, and the cherry on top: Sophia. Like the day wasn’t already a disaster. You’re not gonna believe this, but OMG! She fell into the swimming pool while trying to hit on Harrison! He had to jump in and save the poor thing, who – looked like a sad, wet poodle. Looks like the day had a silver lining after all.
cn: 哦，今天还有更糟的呢，可别忘了索菲娅。我的天，这事说出去别人都不敢信：她搭讪哈里森的时候掉进游泳池了！哈里森还能怎么办呢，他只能跳进游泳池，救上这个可怜的女孩。索菲娅当时看上去简直像个被打湿的伤心贵宾犬。看来今天还不算太糟糕……

en: The next day was a brand-new day, and it was time for olive branches and reconciliations – starting with Carmen. Quinn apologized for being too pushy, and Carmen admitted that she should’ve at least heard her out. Aww, sweet. They proceeded to discuss the remaining dubious suspects: Ziva, Lori, Vance and Harrison – but were interrupted by Vance breezing in. As he does.
cn: 全新的一天开启了，奎因决定心态平和，试着与生活和解——就从和卡门的沟通开始吧。奎因为自己前一日强势的态度诚恳道歉，卡门也表示，自己至少应该听完奎因的观点。真不错，这才是朋友的相处方式。于是，两人开始谈论剩下的嫌疑人：姬瓦、罗莉、万斯和哈里森。不过，万斯像他第一次出场那样，唐突地出现，并打断了两人的谈话。

en: The three of them got chatting, and then the weirdest thing happened: Vance revealed that he was a fan of the recent movie adaptation of one of Ziva’s books, Criminal Concerto. That book was one of Carmen’s favorites, as it’s about a cellist – just like her. Vance turned on the charm, saying that she looks just like the main character, but Carmen pointed out that she’d stopped playing ages ago.
cn: 于是三人聊了起来，他们聊到了一件奇怪的事：万斯说他很喜欢一部电影，那部电影改编自姬瓦的小说《犯罪协奏曲》，巧的是，这也是卡门最爱的书之一，因为这本书的主角和她本人一样，都是大提琴手。万斯指出，卡门和主角一样，都拥有大提琴手特有的魅力。不过卡门表示，她很久以前就不碰大提琴了。

en: It seemed like she’d given up on her art – but all Carmen needed, thought Quinn, was some encouragement. And Quinn had plenty to give. She threw out the bright idea that Carmen could play a piece or two at the opening of the stage they’d been building at the restaurant. It sounded like the perfect idea, but Carmen wasn’t so sure, and said she’d think about it.
cn: 看起来，卡门似乎放弃了成为一名艺术家的机会——不过奎因认为卡门需要的只是一些支持和鼓励，而奎因可最擅长鼓舞打气了。她提出了一个绝妙的点子：餐厅里马上要搭好舞台了，而卡门可以在舞台开幕式上演奏一两首曲子，这是卡门圆梦的好时机。听起来很不错，但卡门有些犹豫，她还需要再考虑一下这个提议。

en: And then guess who showed up? No prizes. It’s Colton again. Like two awkward sea turtles, he and Quinn tried to make conversation, but they both failed miserably and ended up talking about the weather. Painful. Truly painful.
cn: 无奖竞猜，猜猜谁来了？又是科尔顿。他和奎因就像两只尴尬的海龟一样试图交流，但两人都不知道该说点什么，所以最后只能聊起天气。曾经的一对爱侣变成这样，可真悲哀……

en: What they didn’t know was that Sophia was in the audience and saw the entire dumpster fire interaction. But for once, she wasn’t there to tease but to offer some wise(-ish) words for the two of them: stop trying to force it. The troubled couple agreed to put things on pause for a while. Phew.
cn: 两人并没有察觉到索菲娅也在场，她目睹了两人惨不忍睹的互动过程。这次，金发女孩没有恶劣地嘲弄谁，她给出了明智的建议：别强求自己和对方。这对陷入情感危机的前夫妻很赞成，暂且搁置了这段不合时宜的感情。唉……

en: But enough romance! Back to business! Quinn made another call to Lloyd – she wanted to double check something. It wasn’t Harrison that Lloyd had seen sabotaging Vance’s boat, right? The answer seemed obvious, really: golden retriever boy Harrison wasn’t who Lloyd saw – and in fact, Harrison had set off on a fishing trip that day.
cn: 浪漫氛围到此为止，言归正传！奎因又联系了劳埃德，她想再确认一件事。她问劳埃德，那天在万斯船上搞鬼的人不是哈里森，对吧？劳埃德给出了明确的回复：他看到的不是那位金发的渔民男孩儿。而且，哈里森那时候已经出发去钓鱼了。

en: Relieved, Quinn crossed Harrison off her list. That just left Vance, Ziva and Lori as the main suspects.
cn: 奎因终于松了一口气，划掉了列表上哈里森的名字。那么万斯、姬瓦和罗莉就是主要嫌疑人了。
第三十一天~第三十二天

en: Determined to make Carmen the star, Quinn was working hard on preparations for a big show. Sam did his part and encouraged Carmen, but things got emotional. Carmen was still iffy on the idea of returning to the stage. But a particular visitor had something to say about that…
cn: 奎因下定决心，一定要让卡门成为开幕式的焦点，她为这场大型开幕式做足了准备。山姆一边干活，一边鼓励卡门，不过事情还是有些偏离正轨。卡门依然在犹豫，时隔多年，自己是否要再次回到舞台上演奏。这时，一位特别的客人有话要说……

en: Ziva rocked up, and Carmen almost fainted! Imagine your favorite celebrity showing up like that! Quinn made introductions, and Carmen just about managed to keep herself together. But it turns out Ziva RECOGNISED Carmen from one of her previous signing events. Fan girl scream!
cn: 姬瓦来了，卡门几乎激动地要晕过去了！想象一下，你最爱的明星出现在你面前，卡门现在就是这样！奎因把卡门介绍给姬瓦，卡门强装镇定，但她没想到姬瓦还记得自己。姬瓦记得她去过新书签售会！迷妹尖叫！

en: Ziva had written a special message in Carmen’s copy of her book – “never give up on your dreams” – and it seems being reminded of that encounter was exactly what Carmen needed to make her decision. Basking in the inspiration of her favorite author, Carmen finally agreed to do the show.
cn: 姬瓦在卡门的书上留下了一句特别的留言——“永远不要放弃你的梦想”——似乎正是这句话和签售会那场特别的相遇，让卡门下定了决心。她沉浸在偶像的鼓励中，最终同意上场演奏。

en: But that wasn’t all what Ziva was there for…tick-tock goes the clock: it was almost time for Quinn’s answer. Was she going to sell the restaurant? Quinn still wasn’t enticed, but Ziva was still captivated by the property. It didn’t seem like she was backing down anytime soon.
cn: 不过，这可不是姬瓦的全部目的。一分一秒过去了，留给奎因的思考时间所剩无几。奎因要卖掉餐厅么？其实她并没有被姬瓦的条件打动，但卡门也不会立刻让步，她还觊觎着餐厅的房产。

en: Soon after, Mark visited to compare notes with Quinn, but Sam quickly took over proceedings. You’ve never seen anyone fuss so much over a papercut! Sam was trying his best to flirt, and jokingly tried to convince Mark he should get tattoos instead. Mark said he was afraid of needles, but Little Sammy Sweetheart said he could always hold his hand.
cn: 过了一会儿，马克来餐厅了，奎因和他讨论起关于餐厅的意见。不过，山姆很快加入了这场讨论，他还在为马克手上的伤口大惊小怪！这位工匠想尽办法和警官调情，还开起了玩笑，让马克去纹身。但马克拒绝了，他怕针。小甜心山姆立马自荐，说自己可以一直握着他的手，这样就不会痛了哦。

en: Later that day, Carmen made a triumphant return! She was ready with evidence that Ziva wasn’t involved with the wreck: a schedule for Ziva’s book tour. She pointed out that the date Ziva had written that memorable dedication in her book was the same day as the crash. Quinn couldn’t argue with that! So that just left Vance and Lori on the suspect list.
cn: 晚些时候，卡门凯旋而归，并带来了一些对姬瓦有利的证据，那是一份姬瓦巡回签售会的日程表。卡门说，撞船案和签售会在同一天，而且就是那天，姬瓦在签售会上为她写下了那句祝福语。证据确凿，奎因无法反驳！于是嫌疑人只剩下了万斯和罗莉。

en: Apparently unable to help himself, Colton came back the next day with another gift for Olivia – but also the news that he was leaving. For real this time – back to the mainland, and his family. With Colton gone, would Quinn’s heart grow fonder? Or, upon his inevitable return, would he get the same cold shoulder?
cn: 显然，科尔顿无法抑制自己的感情，所以他第二天又来了，并给奥利维亚带了礼物。这次，他真的要离开了，离开浪尾岛，回到本土的家人身边。科尔顿走了，奎因和他的心会更亲近吗？也许，等科尔顿回来时，还会受到奎因的疏离和冷眼？

en: Vance and Lori showed up again, and it became blatantly obvious that Vance would do anything Lori told him to. It’s kind of pathetic, honestly. But Lori didn’t show up with just her boy toy in tow, but also Ziva news. She’d caught wind of a rumor that there was a budding new romance between Ziva and a local resident. It couldn’t possibly be Carmen, could it? What a scandal!
cn: 万斯和罗莉也来了。很明显，万斯的心全在罗莉身上，罗莉让他做什么就做什么，看起来有点可怜。但罗莉不只带来了她的绯闻对象，还带来了关于姬瓦的消息。她听说了一个谣言，传闻称姬瓦和一位浪尾岛本地人正在暧昧。那个人一定不是卡门，对吧？真是个丑闻！

en: But wait! There was even more news – this time Sam’s was the one with the dish, and he was ready to share. He’d heard some gossip from his punk friends about supposed bad-boy Vance. It was well known amongst Sam’s friends that Vance had been kicked out and cut off by his well-off family. Poor kid? Yeah, right.
cn: 等等！还有更多消息，这个瓜来自山姆，他迫不及待就要分享了。他从朋友的朋友那里听闻了万斯的八卦。这位坏男孩来自富裕的家庭，却被家里赶出来，让他自生自灭，还断绝了给万斯的金钱支持。看来，万斯也是个可怜的孩子。

en: Quinn was hungry for more where that came from, so she turned to Amala for more details. A rebellious, greedy rich kid who was fond of getting up to no good for money and status? It sounded more and more like he was the culprit after all. But did he pull his latest stunt just to catch Lori’s attention, or was there something else going on?
cn: 奎因想知道更多内幕，所以她去找了阿玛拉，她知道更多细节。听起来，万斯是个叛逆、贪婪的富家子弟，他为了钱能不惜一切代价，什么事都能做得出来。听起来，万斯就是那个罪魁祸首。那么，他最近做的这些事，究竟是为了吸引罗莉的注意力，还是另有隐情？

en: The day of the concert came around faster than expected! While Quinn, Sam and Amala were hard at work making the final preparations, the subject of their chatter turned to that perennial topic: Colton.
cn: 音乐会的日子很快就到了！奎因、山姆和阿玛拉一边努力做最后的准备，一边闲聊。聊着聊着，他们又谈起奎因的那位前夫：科尔顿。

en: Quinn’s friends revealed that, before leaving Brimwave, Colton had stopped by to talk to both of them – apparently, he wanted to make sure that Quinn was well looked after while he was away. That’s so nice! ...right?
cn: 据奎因的朋友们透露，离开浪尾岛之前，科尔顿分别找他们两人聊过。科尔顿主要是想确保，他不在的这些日子里，奎因的朋友们能照顾好她。他可真不错，不是么？

en: Whatever his intentions, it didn’t help Quinn’s already tangled feelings about him. And then, as if on cue, Harrison showed up to make that knot of feelings even bigger. Quinn, thinking that honesty was the best policy, revealed to him that she was still unsure where her heart lay. He didn’t take it too well, and quickly left, saying that he ‘forgot’ something at the docks. What a mess.
cn: 但无论他的本意是什么，都没有改变奎因对他复杂的感情。然后，就像是爱情电影一样，哈里森的出现让奎因更加纠结。奎因本人认为，在恋爱中，真诚是最重要的，所以她直接向哈里森坦白，说还不确定自己的心意。哈里森看起来不太高兴，很快就离开了。他的借口也很烂，说自己把什么东西落在码头上了。真是一团糟啊。

en: It didn’t get any easier after Olivia chose that moment to tell Quinn how much she liked both Harrison AND Colton! If only Quinn could pick both. Or neither. If she could just figure out which one she really liked, maybe things would be a bit better.
cn: 偏偏奥利维亚在这时也要添乱，这小女孩说她对爸爸和渔人都很喜欢呢！女儿的话让奎因更难以抉择了，如果能两个都要就好了，两个都不要也行……要是奎因真能明白自己的心意，也许就没这么多事了。

en: Turning her attention back to more important matters, Quinn finally hashed things out with Lori and heard her alibi. Lori was on the mainland volunteering at a homeless shelter. Heart of gold, this one!
cn: 但奎因选择把注意力放到更重要的事情上，罗莉也提供了不在场证明，她那天在内陆，参与了帮扶流浪汉的志愿者活动，罗莉真是有金子一般的善心。

en: But despite getting all the information she needed, Quinn was close to breaking point. She’d been going in circles for weeks now, and only getting more freaked out. But luckily, Lori and Olivia were there to help her through it and calm her down before the show. You got this, Quinn!
cn: 虽然案件已经有了些眉目，但奎因还是想快点找到下个突破点。这几周来，奎因一直没有进展，甚至在崩溃的边缘，她的心中也愈发害怕。但幸运的是，罗莉和乖女孩奥利维亚都陪着她，让奎因能冷静地面对即将到来的开幕表演。奎因，你能撑过去的！

en: Ziva arrived with a gift for Carmen’s debut: a brand-new cello. Wowza! Quinn took the time to apologize to Ziva for thinking ill of her and suspecting her of causing the boat accident. She graciously accepts, and the two of them eagerly await Carmen’s arrival.
cn: 姬瓦为卡门的首演带来了一份礼物：一把全新的大提琴。奎因向姬瓦真诚地道歉，坦白说自己对她有些不好的猜测，曾认为姬瓦是造成撞船案的罪魁祸首。姬瓦欣然接受了道歉，原谅了奎因。两人热切地等待着卡门的到来。

en: What showed up instead was a ball of nerves, but Quinn was there to calm Carmen down. It was time for Carmen to step up and live her dream.
cn: 卡门来了，她紧张得要命。但还好有奎因和姬瓦在，卡门也调整到了最好的状态。现在就是她梦想成真的时刻。

en: And she smashed it! Carmen’s performance was seen by everyone, and rightly celebrated as a great success. She even made a few people cry with her music! As the day drew to a close, there was even a sweet romantic moment between Ziva and Carmen. Ziva insisted that she was Carmen’s biggest fan. Someone get the tissues!
cn: 多么美妙的音乐！所有人都沉浸在卡门的音乐里，乐曲结束后，庆祝和喝彩的掌声久久没有停歇。甚至有不少人被乐声打动，流下了真诚的泪水。开幕式结束了，姬瓦和卡门也迎来了浪漫时刻，姬瓦坚称自己已经成为了卡门的头号粉丝。太感人了，拿张纸巾擦擦泪吧！

en: But let’s not forget the elephant in the room, Vance-Pierce Cunningham: the last man standing on Quinn’s suspect list…
cn: 但别忘了正事，那位坏男孩还没解决呢。万斯·皮尔斯·坎宁安，他是奎因名单上的最后一个嫌疑人。
第三十四天~第三十五天

en: Focusing back on the case, Quinn revisited the scene of the bizarre boat crash – and found a pair of sunglasses that may or may not have belonged to Vance. But wait, wasn’t he looking for those a few days before? Weird…
cn: 让我们继续审视撞船案。奎因再次来到离奇的犯罪现场，并发现了一副墨镜。这墨镜或许是万斯的，也可能不属于他。不过，等一下，万斯前几天不就是在找这副眼镜么？真奇怪……

en: Carmen was basking in the afterglow of her great show and was even ready to help Quinn with her case – that is until Ziva came along to whisk her away. Ziva had decided to take Carmen as her plus-one to a fancy little shindig – and they were getting there via her HELICOPTER! Relationship goals. Quinn barely had time to ask for a doggy bag!
cn: 卡门还沉浸在成功的表演中，她兴奋极了，甚至想要帮助奎因一起探索撞船案，不过姬瓦把她接走了。姬瓦决定带着卡门去参加一场豪华宴会，而卡门的身份是她的女伴。她们还要乘坐姬瓦的私人飞机呢！二人的关系得到了巨大进展。姬瓦的动作快到奎因还没反应过来。

en: Amala came by, and Quinn updated her on her latest clue: Vance’s sunglasses. Amala also found it strange, as she’d caught Vance poking around the restaurant a few days before. He had told her he was looking for his sunglasses, but that seemed fishy. Quinn and Amala wonder if the ‘missing sunglasses’ were just an excuse for Vance to snoop around. But what exactly was he looking for?
cn: 阿玛拉过来了，奎因透露了那副墨镜的存在。阿玛拉也觉得非常奇怪，前几天她看到万斯在餐厅附近溜达，他说他丢了一副墨镜，当时万斯的样子也非常可疑。奎因和阿玛拉怀疑，所谓墨镜只是万斯在餐厅周围窥探的借口。所以，万斯到底在找什么？

en: Right on time, Sam offers some more background on Vance: he used to hang around with Sam’s old crowd, but they quickly identified him as a poser. Even back then, no one really liked him. Ouch. He used to vandalize places and was a real wannabe bad-boy. Eventually, he cleaned up his act…but maybe he was going back to his old ways?
cn: 幸好，山姆来了，他带来了万斯的更多背景消息：这男孩曾经和山姆的老朋友混在一起，朋友们很快发现万斯不对劲，他是个装腔作势的人，因此当时没人喜欢他。哦对，他之前特别爱搞破坏，是个典型的小混混。但最后，他改邪归正了……现在看来，他不会又想搞事情吧？

en: That afternoon, Ziva and Carmen returned after leaving the party early – apparently it was a “dog soiree” and both Carmen and Ziva are more cat ladies. But while the two were away, one good thing did happen: Carmen talked Ziva out of her aggressive strategy to buy the restaurant! Instead, Ziva decided to offer Quinn a silent partnership – and Quinn agreed! The start, perhaps, of a beautiful partnership.
cn: 下午，姬瓦和卡门回来了，她们没待太久。宴会明显是狗派作风，但卡门和姬瓦都是猫派。但终于有件好事发生了：卡门劝说姬瓦，让她放弃了收购餐厅的想法！因此姬瓦决定更换策略，与奎因成为餐厅合作人，奎因很快就同意了！或许，这会是个美好的开始。

en: The next day, Harrison was back on the scene. Perhaps sensing Quinn’s recent good luck, he gifted her a lucky cat statue. Or, you know, just because.
cn: 第二天，哈里森又来了。也许是看奎因最近很顺利，他给奎因带来了一个幸运猫摆件，祝愿奎因能够延续运气。

en: Later, Mark came over to compare notes; it turned out that his superiors were discouraging him from investigating, but he was sure there was more to it. They say Vance is innocent, which is hard to believe! Like, seriously!? Quinn was glad to have Mark around – the only person happier was Sam, who not realizing Mark was visiting, bumped into him and dropped a big basket of fruit. His face went SCARLET in embarrassment.
cn: 然后，马克也来和奎因交流意见了。他的上司居然阻止他调查，并说万斯是无辜的，但马克坚信事情没有这么简单，上级的说法很难让人信服。真的，没人会相信吧！马克极力破案，全力支持奎因，奎因高兴极了。但更高兴的是山姆，他一开始没看到马克来了，所以抱着水果篮飞奔过来，结果撞到了马克。山姆窘迫得不行，脸都涨得通红。

en: Anyway, Quinn gave Mark her notes, catching him up to speed on what she’d learned from Lloyd about someone messing with Vance’s boat the night before the crash. Mark, excited for a new lead, said he’d take a look at the local security footage down at the marina.
cn: 奎因把笔记给马克看了，他了解了劳埃德所说的情况，也就是事故发生前一晚，有人在万斯的船上捣乱一事。新线索出现，马克表现得很兴奋，他立马说自己会去看看码头上的监控录像。

en: It really seemed like things were looking up. But Quinn had this uneasy feeling that something wasn’t right…some creepy feeling at the back of her neck. Like she was being watched…but by who? Was it the Gnomes that Norman warned her about – back at their schemes? She wasn’t sure, but Norman urged her to keep on her toes – and NEVER forget the Gnomes.
cn: 事情似乎愈发明朗了，但奎因却不安起来，她总觉得哪里不对劲……潜意识中，好像有人在暗中盯着她，有种毛骨悚然的感觉……是谁？是诺曼所说的地精吗？他们又要耍什么阴谋诡计？虽然奎因不了解传闻的全貌，但她时刻记得老诺曼的警告——永远别忘记愤怒地精。
第三十六天~第三十七天

en: It was time to confront Vance.

Quinn called him over to ask about the sunglasses and quickly caught him right where she wanted him: stuck in his own sticky web of lies. Somehow, he managed to wiggle his way out, but Quinn was onto him.
cn: 奎因把万斯叫来，询问了关于墨镜的事。万斯明显被问住了，他的解释漏洞百出。万斯没解释为什么，反而急着要离开，但奎因盯着他呢。

en: Ziva came by, praising Quinn’s natural skills at decorating and talking up how excited she was about their future partnership. But why did she have to sound so villainous? Ziva admitted that sometimes she can give off antagonistic vibes, but reassured Quinn that her efforts to help were genuine. And she certainly doesn’t want to mess up her budding relationship with Carmen.
cn: 姬瓦顺路来拜访，她称赞了奎因的装修技术，并表示自己无比期待与奎因的合作。但她的语气为什么听起来那么不怀好意呢？姬瓦承认，有时她会表现出针锋相对的感觉，但并不是真心的，而且她想真心对待奎因，真诚地合作。毕竟，她不想搞砸和卡门刚萌芽的感情。

en: Since Ziva was a bestselling writer of romance thrillers, Quinn decided to run her case notes by her. After taking in the details of the mystery, Ziva left Quinn with one piece of advice – a little mantra she sometimes used in her writing: “keep your friends close and your enemies closer.”
cn: 考虑到姬瓦是专业的畅销书作家，并且创作的都是浪漫惊悚小说，奎因决定与她分享案件细节。姬瓦了解了一切细节，并给出了建议，这是一句她常用在小说中的话：“知己知彼才能百战百胜。”

en: After hanging out with Olivia for a short while, Ziva found inspiration in her vivacious imagination and passion for space adventures. Ziva claimed she had an idea for a new book, and it involves Olivia’s space adventures! It was starting to seem like Quinn and Ziva’s partnership was going to work out after all.
cn: 姬瓦和奥利维亚玩了一会儿，她从孩子的想象中获取了灵感，尤其是奥利维亚对太空冒险的热爱打动了她。于是她宣称自己已经有了新书的灵感，并且会把奥利维亚的太空冒险写进去！或许，奎因和姬瓦的伙伴关系进展不错，最后能成功呢。

en: The next day, it was time for even more good news; Mark returned with the footage of the person sabotaging Vance’s boat. But unfortunately, they were wearing a Gnome mask, concealing their identity. Sort of.
cn: 第二天，马克带来了监控视频。这本该是新的线索，但那人戴着地精面具，很难辨认出身份。大概是无法判断嫌疑人了。

en: Quinn, following her instincts, employed Lori to honey-trap Vance. Good thinking, Quinn! Lori, the smooth operator, was able to get Vance to admit that he took money in exchange for sabotaging his own boat and crashing it into Quinn’s restaurant.
cn: 奎因想了一个绝妙的主意，她让罗莉去引诱万斯说出真相。祝你成功，奎因！小酒馆经营者可是十分圆滑的，罗莉真的让万斯承认了他的诡计。万斯说，有人让他开船撞上奎因的餐厅，只要他照做，就能得到一大笔钱。

en: With Mark waiting in the wings to hear the confession, Vance is arrested and taken away to the station. Quinn thanked Lori, but she was just glad to be rid of him – and fair enough! So long, Vance-Pierce Cunningham! Another mystery solved.
cn: 马克听了万斯的招供，于是，这坏男孩被正式逮捕了，再也无法逍遥法外。奎因很感谢罗莉，罗莉也非特别高兴——她终于能摆脱这烦人的追求者了。终于，万斯·皮尔斯·坎宁安落网了，撞船谜团也随之解开！

en: And you know what that means! Another celebration! Quinn had cracked the case – with a little help from her friends, of course. But hold on – there was more! The party was almost cut short as Harrison delivered the news: Amala was too sad to be there because she’d broken up with her boyfriend. Poor thing…
cn: 所以，这意味着什么呢？庆祝时间到！奎因在朋友的帮助下破案了！但等等，还不止这些，哈里森带来了一个消息：阿玛拉和前男友分手了，她伤心得不得了。可怜的女孩……

en: Harrison advised Quinn to wait until Amala was ready to talk and assured her that she’d get by with a little help from trash TV and ice cream for now.
cn: 哈里森建议奎因先不要看她，他已经给阿玛拉准备好了失恋后的必备物品，包括但不限于冰激淋和无聊肥皂剧。

en: In the meantime, there was room for celebration: Mark arrived, not in his board shorts but in uniform, bearing some news…Vance had been booked and was locked up at the station. And he’d even confessed that the Gnomes were the masters pulling the strings all along!
cn: 这时候，庆典开始啦！马克穿得很正式，他知道一些万斯的事情。万斯一直被关着，而且在警局被严密看守。他终于承认了——一直以来，都是地精在背后操控他！

en: Mark gave Quinn a stern warning: the Gnomes were serious business – but Quinn was determined to take them on. But not until after they celebrated their win with a pool party!
cn: 马克严肃地告诫奎因：那群地精是可怕的存在，要千万小心，奎因也牢牢记住了。但以后再想这件事吧，眼下最重要的是泳池派对！

en: A new day, a new project! This time, Quinn was looking to renovate the restaurant’s old greenhouse. It was a big project, and she’d need some help – so it was perfect that Sam was back from his little break.
cn: 新的一天来了，要开始干活了！今天，奎因打算翻新餐厅旁的旧温室。这可是个大项目，她也需要不少帮助，所以山姆结束了他的休假，投入到翻新工作中。

en: But Quinn couldn’t shake Amala from her thoughts; she knew that her friend was upset and wasn’t sure how to help. Harrison contributed some sound advice to Quinn: just be a friend. There’s nothing easier than that.
cn: 但阿玛拉还是没从失恋中走出来，奎因无能为力，她也不知道自己能做点什么。哈里森给奎因提出了些不错的建议：别想太多，做朋友能做的一切就好了。

en: She invited Amala over and heard the woeful tale of Amala and Marcus’s recent troubles. They’d been in a long-distance relationship for ages, but it was hard to sustain. Recently they’d been arguing, and after one fight too many, they’d called it quits. Quinn, putting on her best friend pants, offered the perfect fix for a heartbroken Amala: a girls’ night.
cn: 她邀请阿玛拉来餐厅，并听阿玛拉倾诉了她和男友马库斯的爱情悲剧。他们两个异地恋很久了，但现在无法坚持下去了。前段时间，他们一直吵架，并在某次大吵后提出了分手。奎因作为阿玛拉最好的朋友，提供了一个美妙的方案：女孩时间！

en: Meanwhile, Sam was excited by a new arrival at the greenhouse: a snappily dressed Mark! Apparently, Mark was taking vacation days and offered to help with the greenhouse. It turned out he had a secret talent: gardening!
cn: 同时，山姆也开心得不得了，马克来温室帮忙了，还穿着休闲装！这位警官近期在休假，并且主动帮忙来翻修温室。很少人知道马克的爱好，他其实特别擅长园艺！

en: Quinn couldn’t help but wonder if there was something more to Mark’s sudden leave of absence but tried to keep her focus on Amala. It was all going fine – just like old times – until Sophia appeared. Uh-oh.
cn: 马克突然说自己有事就离开了温室，也没细说原因。于是奎因把注意力转移到阿玛拉身上，一切都那么美好，她俩好像回到了那些旧时光。但是，索菲娅的出现让温馨的气氛全部消散了。

en: Having heard about Amala’s boy trouble, Sophia offered a solution to Amala’s pitiful love life: an app called Heart2Heart. Before Quinn could object, Sophia was giving Amala a crash-course in online dating – and to her surprise, it kinda worked.
cn: 听了阿玛拉分手的遭遇后，索菲娅提了个意见，她说阿玛拉应该下载一个叫“心电心”的app，这是一个交友软件。奎因还没反对呢，索菲娅就直接帮阿玛拉下载了，而且还教会了她怎么使用。app居然为阿玛拉匹配成功了，看来索菲娅的主意还是有点用处的。

en: By the next day, Amala already had multiple matches, and the app had set her up on a couple of phone dates. Why does every dating app need to have a gimmick these days? Quinn didn’t have much choice but to go along with Sophia’s grand plan.
cn: 第二天，阿玛拉的app上已经出现了不少匹配对象，app甚至还给她安排了一场电话相亲。看来现在的相亲软件都有两把刷子啊！奎因还能说什么呢？其实阿玛拉也算暂时走出了失恋的阴影吧。

en: Over in the boys’ camp, the sparks weren’t exactly flying, much as Sam was wanting them to. Instead, Mark was inclined to share a little about his reputation at his job. Since his dad was the first to work the Gnome case, Mark had inherited a ‘golden boy’ reputation.
cn: 反观男孩子那边，氛围就没有这么浪漫了，现实并没有像山姆所期望的那样，擦出爱的火花。马克一直都在讲他工作的事情，他还说自己在警局晋升得很快，因为他爸爸曾经是第一个调查地精案件的警察。
第四十一天~第四十三天

en: With Mark committing to the greenhouse renovations, Quinn became determined to figure out his deal. Mark didn’t take vacations…so why now? But even though Quinn was ready to interrogate Mark, she still had to consider Amala and her friendship duties.
cn: 马克正努力翻修温室，奎因却还是心存疑虑。马克并没有真正休假，而是请假了，他为什么要在这几天请假呢？奎因一边想着如何审问马克，一边尽朋友的职责关心阿玛拉。

en: Amala was facing her first date with a guy called Chad (why is it always a Chad?), and despite Quinn’s valiant efforts to encourage her, the date took a nosedive almost straight away. Chad was boastful, rude, and somehow managed to push all of Amala’s buttons. She ended the call shouting at him and threatened to give up on the whole idea of dating.
cn: 阿玛拉马上就要迎来她的第一场约会了，那男人名叫查德（怎么老有叫查德的啊），尽管奎因用尽全力鼓励阿玛拉，但约会还是一团糟。查德是个自说自话的自大狂，他粗暴无礼，完全踩中阿玛拉的所有雷点。她生气地对查德怒吼，然后挂断了电话。阿玛拉简直被这无礼的匹配对象吓到了，甚至再也不想约会了。

en: But Sophia descended like a hawk and talked Amala into trying at least one more date. Quinn, wanting to be encouraging, agreed – one more try couldn’t hurt, right?
cn: 索菲娅出现了，她劝说阿玛拉再试着约会一次，奎因也赞同。毕竟，多试一次能有什么坏处呢？

en: Meanwhile, there was another couple dominating the world of romance: Ziva and Carmen! And they were on FIRE! It hadn’t taken long for Ziva to bring Carmen into her world of socialites and dog soirees. Carmen had even gotten invitations to perform at parties, and spent time schmoozing with high-society snobs. Quinn tried to shake off her quiet, private worry that the two of them were moving too fast.
cn: 这时，又有一对情侣坠入爱河了——姬瓦和卡门简直谈得热火朝天！姬瓦完全将卡门带入了她的世界，她们一起去参加宴会，与名流打交道。卡门还受邀在宴会上表演大提琴，她见到了不少上流社会的势利眼。奎因觉得她俩的进展有点快了，但她压下了这份担忧。

en: Sam was starting to get somewhere with Mark, too – and even managed to pick out Mark’s favorite flowers for a little arrangement. Super cute.
cn: 山姆也和马克有了一些进展，他专门挑马克喜欢的花布置了温室，真的超级可爱。

en: But it seems that kind of success wasn’t meant for Amala. On her second date – with a soft-spoken high school guidance counselor named Jack – it almost looked like there was a chance…at first. But there were no flying sparks, and Amala left disappointed.
cn: 阿玛拉开启了第二场约会，依然不怎么顺利。这位匹配对象名叫杰克，是一位高中辅导员，他说起话来轻声细语，两人之间没擦出任何火花，于是阿玛拉失望地离开了。

en: Whoa! Looks like there WAS a hidden reason for Mark’s sudden lack of uniform – he wasn’t just on vacation, he’d been SUSPENDED. Who knew Mark was a bad boy!?
cn: 咦，马克没穿制服！所以，他不是在休假，而是被停职了。马克究竟犯了什么事？！

en: Of course, Quinn started digging for more info; Mark explained that he had been punished for investigating Vance, despite being warned not to. Perhaps, Quinn feared, the Gnomes’ influence had even spread to the Brimwave police department.
cn: 于是，奎因就问了马克，马克的说法是，当时警局上级一直警告他不要调查万斯，但他没听劝，把万斯抓捕了，因此受到了惩罚。奎因担心极了，或许地精的势力已经渗透了浪尾岛警署部门。

en: Quinn couldn’t worry about that, though: with Amala upset, she had to do something. She called on Harrison to play peacemaker, and managed to give a sincere apology to Amala, who graciously accepted.
cn: 不过，奎因现在该操心的不是这个。她得为好朋友做点什么，所以奎因找哈里森做和事佬，向阿玛拉进行了真诚的道歉，承认最近自己忽视了阿玛拉的心情，阿玛拉当然欣然接受了。

en: The mystery was only deepening, and though Quinn had her two best friends by her side, there was still one person missing: her dad.
cn: 这个谜团越来越离谱，不仅身边两个最好的朋友出了岔子，还有一个人失踪了：她的父亲。
第四十四天~第四十七天

en: Just when things seemed to be calming down again, another ominous omen appeared on Quinn’s doorstep: a leaflet with the words ‘HISTORY REPEATS ITSELF’ scrawled on it.
cn: 最近似乎风平浪静，然而，一张不祥的纸却打破了这份平静。这张纸出现在奎因的家门口，上面写着几个大字：“历史会重演”。

en: The leaflet – which looked to be advertising the ‘Big Beach Ball Mall’ – seemed fairly old, with the words clearly added more recently. It was an utterly perplexing piece of evidence, and Quinn didn’t quite know where to start.
cn: 这是张宣传“大沙滩球购物中心”的传单，看起来有些年头了，而几个字明显是最近才写上的。真是令人不安又困惑，奎因根本无从下手。

en: Even if she had, she’d have been immediately sidetracked – because guess who called? That’s right: Colton. The man just couldn’t stay away. He called to say he was coming back soon – which obviously didn’t impress Quinn. And Harrison wasn’t too happy about it, either!
cn: 就算奎因有些想法，她现在也没法开始调查——某个人的电话打扰了她的思路。猜猜是谁打来的？没错，就是科尔顿，这男人永远都惦记着奎因。他打电话告诉奎因，自己马上就会回到浪尾岛。不过奎因对此没什么表示，哈里森得知后也不太高兴！

en: Instead, Quinn distracted herself and tried to focus on the mystery of the leaflet (a classic Quinn move) by asking Amala and Lori if they knew anything about the ‘Big Beach Ball Mall’. Neither of them had heard of it, but Lori mentioned that the last time someone tried to build a mall in Brimwave, it never got off the ground. Coincidence? I think not!
cn: 奎因把自己的注意力放到传单上，她分别去问阿玛拉和罗莉，问她们是否知道传单上的“大沙滩球购物中心”，但她们压根没听说过。不过，罗莉提到，之前有人试图在浪尾岛建造一个购物中心，但一直都没开工。这是个巧合吗？不太像哦。

en: Meanwhile, more drama was brewing. Amala had something to tell Quinn, and she was kind of cautious about her reaction. Amala had come across Harrison on the dating app, Heart2Heart. Quinn had mixed feelings about the news, but decided it wasn’t any of her business.
cn: 同时，更多好戏正在酝酿开场。阿玛拉有话要说，她看起来不知道怎么开口：哈里森居然也在“心电心”相亲app上，阿玛拉看到了他的个人社交账号。奎因听后心情复杂，但她认为这是哈里森的个人自由。

en: Not long after, Quinn got into an argument with Carmen – it turns out you probably shouldn’t try and tell your friend who’s been single for AGES that she might be moving too fast. And on top of that, she started pressing Carmen about the Gnomes again. Let’s just say it ended badly.
cn: 不久后，奎因和卡门之间再次爆发了争吵。她俩的破裂证明，不要试图干涉朋友的感情问题，尤其是你觉得朋友的感情进展太快了的时候，永远别说。最糟糕的是，奎因又提到了地精，不断地追问，结局当然是糟糕透了。

en: However, Quinn WAS making progress on the mysterious leaflet front. While Sam thought the idea of a mall was cool, Sophia ruled out the possibility that Ziva would be involved in such a tacky project. Instead, it seemed that the ‘Big Beach Ball Mall’ project was linked to Brimwave’s history. Mark, recognizing the name, suggested that Quinn should talk to Norman about it.
cn: 不过，传单一事有了新的进展。山姆认为购物中心很酷，但索菲娅认为，姬瓦不会在这种俗气的项目上参与投资。马克知道这个商场的名字，“大沙滩球购物中心”似乎与浪尾岛的历史有关，他建议奎因去问问诺曼。

en: Norman proved right away that he was definitely the person to talk to. Back in the eighties, he had fearlessly led a local protest group that campaigned against the construction of the infamous ‘Big Beach Ball Mall’.
cn: 诺曼听闻后，表示奎因可问对人了。在八十年代，他领导了一个抗议组织，专门与购物中心背后的资本对抗，他们反对在浪尾岛上建造“大沙滩球购物中心”，当时这个商场简直臭名昭著。

en: The insidious corporation behind the mall had been trying to acquire the land Quinn’s restaurant was built on, and Norman’s group – together with Carmen’s parents and other Brimwave residents – had managed to stop them.
cn: 购物中心背后的公司十分阴险，一直在试图收购奎因餐厅的地产。诺曼的组织一直都在抗争这种卑鄙行为，卡门的父母也在组织里呢。结果是，他们暂时成功了。

en: And the name of their group? The Bitter Gnomes.
cn: 你问这组织叫什么？叫“愤怒地精”！

en: That’s right! Norman was once the leader of the Gnomes – but it seemed the group had changed their principles since he had been in charge. Now the question is: why? And what were they up to?
cn: 没错，诺曼曾经是地精的领导者。不过，现在看来，地精已经抛弃了原来的初衷，完全改变了。问题是，地精为什么会变成现在这样？他们的目的又是什么？

en: Well, it did seem inevitable, didn’t it? Colton was back on the scene, and he had plans.
cn: 科尔顿的回归看起来是不可避免的，他自有计划。

en: While back home in Soldale for the past few weeks, Colton had been hitting the weights, and he brought that gym bro energy back to Brimwave. Overcome with excitement to get his family back together and get them fit, he quickly proposed turning one of the restaurant’s disused rooms into a gym. Quinn wasn’t convinced but she couldn’t help but give him a chance.
cn: 过去的几周，他回到了内陆的家中，并一直在举铁、训练肌肉，于是他也把健身的风气带到了浪尾岛。科尔顿觉得自己能挽回家人，而且带着她们一起强身健体，他兴奋极了。所以科尔顿提出将餐厅的一个废弃房间改造为健身房。奎因其实并没有被说服，但她还是想给前夫一个机会。

en: Nothing could be simple in Quinn’s world, could it? She soon discovered some suspicious, sandy footprints in the kitchen that didn’t seem to belong to anyone they knew.
cn: 奎因的世界里总是困难重重，这不，她又发现了一些奇怪的东西。厨房里有些可疑的脚印，这脚印不属于她们任何人。

en: But wait, there’s more! A bunch of fish was missing from the freezer! It looked like another mystery was afoot. And it was just as well! Quinn probably needed a distraction from Colton’s overenthusiastic return.
cn: 等会儿，事情还没这么简单。冰柜里的鱼少了很多！看起来，又来了一个谜团。奎因认为，是时候从科尔顿的热情提议中抽离出来，调查这奇怪的一切了。

en: The next day, she invited Mark round to help make some professional theories about where the footprints came from. Mark was pretty confident they were from a man, and as if right on cue, a barefoot Harrison showed his face. Or…feet? Either way, that’s that mystery solved. Right?
cn: 第二天，奎因把马克请了过来，这位警官当然知道关于脚印的专业知识。马克看后，自信地表示这脚印属于一个男性，于是，一张人脸在所有人的脑海中浮现……哈里森？他有时候就不穿鞋……这谜团看似解开了，但哈里森为什么要偷鱼呢？

en: Mark granted Quinn the title of ‘Junior Detective’ for her stellar work. But hold on…why would Harrison, a fisherman, be stealing fish? It simply didn’t add up. Was there some kind of connection between the Gnomes, the ‘Big Beach Ball Mall’, and the missing fish?
cn: 马克授予奎因“初级侦探”的称号，她已经具备了破案的潜质。但稍等一下，为什么哈里森一个渔民会偷鱼啊？这说不通吧。这些鱼和地精、大沙滩球购物中心有什么关系么？

en: Despite Quinn’s efforts to distract herself, Colton was somehow becoming less annoying. Quinn hated to admit it: she was missing the early days of their relationship – back before they opened the restaurant. The good old days…
cn: 奎因努力让自己别多想，她同时发现，科尔顿似乎没有原来那么烦人了。这时，奎因不得不承认，她开始怀念原来那段恋爱的日子，当时还没有餐厅，真的非常美好……

en: If only Colton would stop being so immature! He was clearly still jealous of Harrison – and even suggested that Harrison could be purposefully undersupplying them with fish, but Quinn was quick to dismiss that as nonsense.
cn: 如果当时，科尔顿再成熟一点就好了！他还在嫉妒哈里森，甚至明说哈里森可能缺斤少两，少给了很多鱼，但奎因认为，这当然不可能。

en: Colton had an ace in the hole, though: while he was back home, he’d paid off his debts. But not by himself. His family had helped him out of his fiscal catastrophe, and Colton was more than ready to turn over a new leaf. He said that he was ready to be dedicated to THEIR family now. Oh, the sweet melody of responsibility – music to Quinn’s ears…
cn: 不过，科尔顿在挽回奎因这件事上亮出了王牌——他已经把债务还清了，虽然是他家人帮他还的吧，但他已经摆脱了债务问题，准备开启新的人生了。科尔顿诚恳地说，他愿意为家庭付出一切。哦，真是个负责的男人，奎因有点沦陷了，耳畔响起了浪漫的音乐……

en: …but at the moment they almost kissed, Harrison walked in. Ahem. Way to ruin a moment.
cn: 两人越来越近……马上就要吻在一起了！这一刻，哈里森走了进来，彻底破坏了浪漫的氛围。

en: Maybe there was still a spark – somewhere, deep down. But either way, there was a rocky road ahead.
cn: 或许吧，他们的心中都还保留着爱的火花，只是藏得太深了。但不论如何，前方都是崎岖而困难的。
第五十一天~第五十二天

en: A new clue! While clearing out some junk to make way for yet more gym equipment, Quinn and Colton found a tiny little fish, stripped to the bone. What the heck!?
cn: 奎因和科尔顿在一起清理垃圾，他们打算为健身房腾出一些空间。突然，一条新的线索出现了，他们发现了一条小鱼的鱼骨，什么意思？

en: Colton was insistent that they must have rats and offered to call an exterminator – but after Quinn dismissed that idea, Colton set his sights on Sam. Sam quickly proved his loyalty (because he’s a sweetheart) by offering to pay for replacement fish with his own money.
cn: 科尔顿坚持认为这是老鼠搞的鬼，并打算进行一些灭鼠操作。但奎因觉得不可能，于是科尔顿又开始怀疑是山姆偷了鱼，但山姆很快就澄清了自己，一方面是因为他一直是个乐于助人的小甜心，另一方面是因为，这些鱼是他自费为餐厅购买的。

en: Tired of all of Colton’s silly accusations, Quinn turned her focus to something more important, and called Carmen over to apologize for their fight – but of course it didn't go well at all. It was up to Lori to step in and break up their little tiff.
cn: 科尔顿的解释真的有点蠢，奎因也不想和他掰扯了，她把注意力转移到更重要的事情上。奎因给卡门打了个电话，对二人的争吵主动道歉，但不太顺利。于是，罗莉开始帮忙修补两人的嫌隙。

en: Luckily, the next day Colton was out running errands – which gave Quinn a chance to clear her head. She met with Ziva, who praised the idea of turning the backroom into a gym – but revealed that she had other reasons for her visit.
cn: 还好，科尔顿第二天出去办事了，奎因终于有时间清醒一下了。她去见了姬瓦，姬瓦称赞了关于健身房的想法，不过她透露，自己此行还有一个目的。

en: The squabble between Quinn and Carmen had gone on for long enough, and Ziva was ready to extinguish it. Seeing no reason to keep Ziva in the dark, Quinn finally explained to her all the mysteries surrounding the restaurant. Ziva listened, and promised to talk to Carmen about how much Quinn needed her help.
cn: 奎因和卡门的争吵已经持续了太长时间，奎因希望姬瓦插手，帮她们和好。此外，奎因觉得没必要向姬瓦隐瞒了，向她说出了餐厅的所有谜团。姬瓦听后，答应了奎因的请求，表示自己要去和卡门谈谈。

en: But then a new twist revealed itself! Sophia came with some spicy news: she’d matched with Harrison on Heart2Heart. Harrison, you naughty boy!
cn: 然后就发生了一件狗血的事！索菲娅过来对奎因说，她在心电心app上和哈里森配对成功了。现在我们这里是什么情况？

en: Quinn tried to act unbothered, but she couldn’t help but feel a little hurt – especially after Sophia accused her of being “all over” Harrison not too long ago. Sophia was, apparently, trying her hardest to make a complicated love triangle into a love square. What a mess!
cn: 奎因装出一副不在乎的样子，但她心里还是有点受伤，索菲娅还指责她对哈里森不专一。显然，索菲娅的加入让这段三角恋变得更奇怪了，他们几个简直都能组成配对群体了，真是一团糟！

en: It appeared that things around the restaurant had hit a lull…but not for long – Olivia came screaming “Monster, monster!”
cn: 餐厅周围似乎是没什么奇怪的事了……但好景不长，奥利维亚突然尖叫着跑来，她大喊：“怪物，怪物！”

en: Apparently, after sneaking into the freezer to take an ice cream, she’d seen something move in the shadows. Colton stepped up to go and face the monster…
cn: 这孩子偷偷溜到冰箱，想去拿冰激淋，却看到阴影处有什么在移动，科尔顿站出来了，走上去一探究竟……

en: …but in the end, it wasn’t a spine-tingling monster. Instead, all they found was a very satisfied Coconut rolling around in an endless supply of fishy treats.
cn: 其实，根本就不是什么怪物，而是滚来滚去的小椰子——它一身鱼腥味，在冰柜里滚来滚起，开自助餐呢。

en: What a hullabaloo over nothing! Maybe Quinn’s mystery senses weren’t fully attuned. Or maybe her senses were clouded by all the drama. Either way, she was glad it wasn’t another Gnome plot.
cn: 奎因心里终于松了口气，还好不是什么地精的阴谋！奎因体质特殊，太容易陷入奇怪的谜团里了，她已经习惯了这些，却依然有些累。不管如何，现在的结局是好的！

en: But she knew it was only a matter of time until a new diabolical plan unfolded…
cn: 但奎因知道，事情还没有结束呢，地精的邪恶计划还需要时间……

en: As one of Brimwave's most successful entrepreneurs, Lori made a name for herself long before Quinn came on the scene. Her love of cooking came at a young age, after seeing how food brought joy to her family at Christmas. Since then, she's aimed to create that same feeling of togetherness for her customers. Despite all of her success, including numerous awards and accolades, she still yearns for something more…companionship.

en: You're just the distraction I needed! I've been writing for hours.
cn: 你来得正好！我写了好几个小时的东西了，急需摸鱼！

en: Hold on – I need to bookmark my thought process.
cn: 等等，我得先把刚刚的灵感写下来。

en: Sorry about the mess, I'm in the middle of a manuscript.
cn: 桌子太乱别见怪，赶稿子呢。

en: Oh good, a visitor! I've been talking to myself and the wall all day.
cn: 快来和我聊聊天，我已经对着空气自言自语一整天了。

en: Don't be shy! Come in. Tell me your favorite story…
cn: 别害羞，进来吧。跟我说说你最喜欢哪个故事……

en: Ah, I see the muses have you up late as well.
cn: 啊，看来你也半夜灵感爆发？

en: I get some of my best ideas after midnight.
cn: 我总在半夜突然冒出好多绝妙的点子。

en: Hmm, you know what we need? A warm drink.
cn: 你说我们是不是该来杯热乎乎的饮料？

en: Another bright morning. Another blank page!
I had quite the dream last night. It could be a story…
cn: 我昨晚做了一个梦，也许能写成一个故事……

en: My morning routine: coffee, brainstorm, write.
cn: 我的清晨三件套，永远都是咖啡、头脑风暴和写作。

en: You know what this day needs? A good beach read.
cn: 你知道吗？今天特别适合读一本消遣的小说。

en: I wasn't expecting a visit. How about we grab some lunch?
cn: 没想到会有客人来，一起吃个午餐如何？

en: What a perfect day! Hold on, I need to write this down.
cn: 天气太棒了！等等，我得赶紧把这个记下来。

en: Golden hour, the time of love and inspiration.
cn: 黄金时刻，爱与灵感的绽放时分。

en: A toast to the day, and for the night ahead.
cn: 敬这美好的一天，也敬即将到来的夜晚。

en: You're just in time, I was about to head to a little party!
cn: 来得正好！我正要去个小派对呢！

en: Ah, the night is still young and full of romance.
Do you hear that? The night has a rhythm, let's see where it'll go.
cn: 你听到了吗？夜晚自有韵律，且随它起舞。

en: I know it's cliché, but I love writing.
cn: 虽是老生常谈，但我就是爱写作。

en: For me? You shouldn't have, but I'm happy you did.
cn: 给我的吗？你太客气了，但我很开心。

en: You're too kind. Now I must return the gesture!
cn: 你太好啦，现在该轮到我回礼了！

en: Is it my birthday? Happy birthday to me!
cn: 今天是我生日吗？祝我生日快乐！

en: Really, you spoil me! I can't believe you got this for me.
cn: 你太宠我了！真不敢相信你为我准备了这些。

en: I love it! And I know exactly where I'll put it.
cn: 我超喜欢这个！我已经想好要把它放在哪儿了。

en: Well, you've just made my day. Thank you!
cn: 哇，你照亮了我的一天，谢谢你！

en: You've outwritten me with this one. I love it!
cn: 这篇你写得比我好多了，我超级喜欢！

en: What a thoughtful surprise. I see someone's read my bio page.
cn: 好贴心的惊喜，看来有人偷偷研究过我的个人资料。

en: Myself and the muses are grateful. Truly, thank you.
cn: 我和缪斯女神都很感激，真的谢谢你。

en: And I was in such a slump. Thanks for making this day better.
cn: 本来今天有些打不起精神，现在感觉好多啦，谢谢你。

en: Looks like we've entered a new chapter – called friendship!
cn: 看起来我们的关系又更近一层了？

en: You, my friend, were the unexpected plot twist I needed.
cn: 朋友，你简直是我的人生小说里最棒的神转折。

en: Every protagonist needs a confidant, and I've found mine.
cn: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻。我终于找到自己的知己啦。

en: Cheers! To new friends and new wild stories to tell!
cn: 干杯！敬新朋友，敬未来的狂野故事！

en: Who needs a bestseller when I've got a best friend like you?
cn: 还追求什么畅销书？有你这样的朋友此生足矣。

en: I couldn't help myself – I hope you like it.
cn: 我忍不住给你买了这个，希望你喜欢。

en: Don't worry, it's just a little something that reminded me of you.
cn: 别客气，只是因为这个小玩意儿让我想起了你。

en: You've inspired me, so I hope this inspires you too.
cn: 你总能启发我，希望这个也能给你灵感。

en: I knew it was perfect for you the moment I saw it. Enjoy!
cn: 第一眼看到它就觉得非你莫属，好好享受吧！

en: Oh, that smile is worth a million and more words.
cn: 啊，你的笑容可比千言万语都珍贵呢。

en: I knew it'd suit you! I hope you like it.
cn: 我就知道适合你！希望你喜欢这份礼物。

en: Ziva made a big splash when she moved into Brimwave, and it’s no surprise, given that she's her generation’s top romance-thriller writer. Ziva is, as some say, the epitome of success – but her journey wasn’t easy, coming from a humble but wildly talented family. She is the only child of renowned jazz musicians Louis and Simone Bates. Ziva was determined to follow the same creative path her parents had paved – but found herself on an altogether more complicated one. She's achieved great success…but at what cost?
cn: 姬瓦搬到浪尾岛时引起了不小的轰动，这并不奇怪，她可是同代作家中最出色的浪漫惊悚小说写手。正如一些人所说，姬瓦是成功的典范，但她的成功之旅并非一片坦途。姬瓦出生于一个低调的艺术家家庭，她是著名爵士音乐家路易斯和西蒙娜·贝茨的独生女。因此，姬瓦本该继承父母衣钵，但她最终选择了一条更为坎坷的道路。她已经获得了伟大的成就，但……代价是什么呢？

en: I should really restring my cello soon…
cn: 我真该尽快给我的大提琴换弦了……

en: Hold that thought. I’m working on a new composition.
cn: 先别急。我正在创作一首新曲子。

en: Stay. I think you’ll like this song…
cn: 留下来吧。我想你会喜欢这首歌的……

en: A song always sounds different the second time.
cn: 一首歌第二次听起来总是不一样的。

en: Please! Do NOT get me started on trumpet players.
cn: 拜托！别让我开始吐槽小号手。

en: My favorite composer? Geez, I don’t know. Let me think…
cn: 我最喜欢的作曲家？天哪，我不知道。让我想想……

en: Oh, I’m sorry. Did my music keep you up?
cn: 哦，抱歉。我的音乐吵得你睡不着吗？

en: The weather’s perfect for a midnight stroll. Want to come?
cn: 天气很适合午夜散步。想一起来吗？

en: It’s easier to play when everyone else is asleep…
cn: 大家都睡着的时候演奏起来更容易……

en: Oh, I’m sorry. Did I wake you up with my playing?
cn: 哦，抱歉。我演奏的声音把你吵醒了吗？

en: I'm not sure what I'll do today. Do you?
cn: 我不确定今天要做什么。你知道吗？

en: Hmm, I wasn’t expecting you here. But it’s nice to see you.
cn: 嗯，没想到你会在这儿。不过见到你真好。

en: I was just about to grab lunch – perhaps you'd like to tag along?
cn: 我正要去吃午饭——也许你想一起来？

en: Retreating from the sun, too? It gets so hot in Brimwave.
cn: 你也是来躲太阳的？浪尾岛真是太热了。

en: Don’t mind me, I’m catching up on my podcasts.
I might have leftovers for dinner. Unless you have a better idea.
cn: 我晚饭可能吃剩菜。除非你有更好的主意。

en: Now that you’re here: want to be my plus-one for a show tonight?
cn: 既然你来了：想当我今晚看演出的同伴吗？

en: There’s something about listening to classical music at night.
cn: 夜晚听古典音乐有种特别的感觉。

en: Oh me? I'm just trying to get my steps in before bed.
cn: 哦我？我只是想在睡前走够步数。

en: Ah, finally some peace and quiet.
This is new…people giving me things…
cn: 这还是头一回……有人给我送东西……

en: Huh, who knew that I wanted this? I guess you did.
cn: 嗯，谁知道我想要这个呢？我猜你知道。

en: Looks like I’ll need a new trinket shelf…
cn: 看来我需要一个新的小摆设架了……

en: This is not what I was expecting…but thank you.
cn: 这不是我预料中的……但还是谢谢你。

en: You have a knack for finding exactly what I like.
cn: 你很擅长找到我喜欢的东西。
真不敢相信你注意到了……

en: You didn’t have to go out of your way for me.
cn: 你不必为我特意费心的。
出乎意料，我很喜欢这个……非常喜欢。

en: I don’t have anything else to say except thank you.
cn: 除了谢谢我也不知道该说什么了。
我很惊讶你还留在这里……

en: Hey, maybe we could play together one day.
cn: 嘿，也许哪天我们可以一起玩。

en: I’m starting not to mind you so much. Which is nice…
cn: 我开始不那么介意你了。感觉还挺好的……

en: You can stay as long as you want.
I think it’s time for me to compose that duet…for you and me.
cn: 我想是时候谱写那首二重奏了……为你和我。

en: It’s nothing too elaborate…just a little something for you.
cn: 没什么特别精致的……只是给你的一点小心意。

en: I thought you might need this.
You’ll understand once you open it.
See? I knew it was exactly what you needed.
cn: 看吧？我就知道这正是你需要的。

en: You don’t have to thank me. Really…
It’s okay if you don’t like it. I’ll do better next time.
cn: 如果你不喜欢也没关系。下次我会做得更好。

en: Carmen puts together an irresistible mystery…

en: Later that evening, Dominic checks in with Carmen after a long day of babysitting…

en: Later that day, Carmen runs into a familiar face that's also returned to Brimwave…

en: Carmen's an unlikely babysitter, but Quinn has enough energy for them both…'til the end of the day.
