en: Carmen always dreamt of life off the island. She left Brimwave to pursue her passion for the cello but returned to care for her aging parents and work at the restaurant. At first, she resented it, but after selling the restaurant to Quinn, Carmen returned to her passion: the cello. Returning to Brimwave meant confronting past shadows and broken promises. Will she ever fully regain her passion?
cn: 卡门一直梦想着离岛生活。她离开浪尾岛追求对大提琴的热爱，但后来回来照顾年迈的父母并在餐厅工作。起初她对此心怀怨恨，但在把餐厅卖给奎因后，卡门重拾了她的热情：大提琴。回到浪尾岛意味着要面对过去的阴影和破碎的承诺。她能完全找回自己的热情吗？

</line-height>Together, we've been through a lot of fun kitchen challenges, tantalizing rumors, thrilling mysteries, and more. We'll continue to bring the fun and excitement for each and every visit to Brimwave's shores!<line-height=75%>

</line-height>To celebrate, here’s a <color=#c8531f>special anniversary gift</color>, just for you!
cn:
<color=#c8531f>{0}</color>天前，<color=#c8531f>{1}</color>，是你首次来到浪尾岛的日子。<line-height=85%>

</line-height>四季流转，海浪依旧。我们一起制作美味佳肴，也一起探寻过岛上的秘密。每一道料理都藏着故事，每一次相聚都值得庆祝。四年光阴写满日记，下一页，我们未完待续。<line-height=85%>

</line-height>惊喜菜单：<color=#c8531f>四周年纪念礼物</color>已解锁，愿你的冲"浪"时光岁岁有今朝，年年皆欢喜！

cn: 咦？我们好像多了一个新的云朵树苗！

en: Tap to sow the saplings in the field, and we'll get a new Cumulus Oak.
cn: 点击将新树苗种到云朵田中，即可获得一棵新的云朵树。

en: Remember: each plant yields one Cirrus Cutie and one Star Net can harvest many Cumulus Trees.

cn: 我有一个<color=#ff60db>比较着急的订单</color>。你愿意帮我吗？

en: A special customer is here! Let's learn more about their order.
cn: 一位特殊的顾客光临！让我们来了解一下它的订单详情。

en: Help Quinn figure out why the moon keeps flickering in the Mid-Autumn sky!
cn: 中秋将至，月亮却忽明忽暗！\n帮助奎因探明真相！

en: Rescue the rabbit in the pond
Place the cushion below the tree
Walk further up the celestial mountain
Rescue the puppy from the moon
Give the golden toad the osmanthus branch
Quinn solved the mystery and saved the mischievous puppy! Time to go home and celebrate the Mid-Autumn festival!
cn: 奎因查明了真相，救下了调皮的小狗！回家过中秋节吧！

en: Quinn figured out the problem! Time to go home and celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival!
cn: 奎因解决了问题，回家过中秋节吧！

en: It was the silly dog impacting the moon all along! Let's bring it home to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival!
cn: 原来是调皮的小狗影响了月光！带他一起回家过中秋节吧！

en: Use Energy to complete tasks and get closer to our mission objective!
cn: 消耗体力清除路上的障碍!

en: \nMission Control will update key tasks to help us complete our mission!
cn: 任务中心会发布关键任务帮我们更快找到真相!

en: Let's do our best to find the target location!
cn: 试试定位到任务目的地吧!

en: We've got a special backpack for all the cool stuff we find! Tap to open it.
cn: 我们采集到了一些物品，打开背包看看都有什么。

en: Tap here to release the items – then we can merge them to earn rewards!
cn: 点击这里将物品释放出来，合并物品解锁惊喜奖励！

en: Let's push forward and explore once we're all rested up!
cn: 休息好了就抓紧向前探索吧!

en: If we get lost, we can look at Mission Control to figure out what to do!
cn: 迷路的时候不妨看看“任务中心”寻找方向!

en: There's a mysterious painted scroll up ahead! Let's go take a look!
cn: 前面好像有个神奇的卷轴，快去看看吧！

en: Let's think of a way to rescue the rabbit from the tree!
cn: 想想办法把树上的小兔子救下来吧！

en: You found the water basin and ladle—put out the fire, quick!
cn: 找到了水盆和水瓢，快回去灭火吧！

en: How can we wake the sleeping rabbits?
cn: 怎样才能唤醒睡着的兔子呢？

en: Is that the celestial dog gnawing on the moon? Quick—let's go see!
cn: 是远处那只小狗在咬着月亮吗？快去看看！

en: Turns out the puppy jumped too high up and can't get back down! Let's find a way to catch it safely!
cn: 原来小狗跳太高不敢下来了，快想办法接住他？

en: Okay, so I wasn't just tired—the moon WAS flickering like an old lightbulb!
cn: 所以不是我眼花了，月亮真的和坏灯泡一样一闪一闪的！

en: And that creature biting into it was some kind of…gigantic wolf?
cn: 那个窜到月亮上的是什么……？黑乎乎的看起来好像是个狼？

en: Olivia's mythology books talked about a celestial jaguar or a dog or something, but they're just myths!
cn: 奥利维亚的神话书里好像有这么个天狼还是天狗吃月亮的故事……但那就是故事啊！

en: I guess I should get a closer look first. I'll try to go somewhere without so many lights and buildings…
cn: 以防万一还是过去看看吧，找个没有光污染的地方仔细观察一下。

en: What's that on the road? Some sort of…disc?
cn: 路面上掉了个什么东西？好像个盖子？

en: It looks like wicker or maybe bamboo…a basket? Or maybe a steamer? But why is it in the middle of the road?
cn: 又感觉看起来像个小竹筏……但是太小了吧……而且还在路中间。

en: I guess I'll take it with me until I find a trash can or whoever's missing the lid to their steamer.
cn: 我还是先收着吧，万一之后有什么人缺个盖子呢？

en: Wait, this isn't where I was trying to go…
Where did this lotus pond come from? And is that…a rabbit?! How did it get stuck in the middle of the pond?
cn: 我记得浪尾岛上没有野生荷花池啊？而且……荷叶上怎么困着一只小兔子？

en: Oh, the poor thing is so scared, and the pond is so deep! How can I help it cross the water?
cn: 可怜的小东西吓坏了，目测这个池子还挺深，我得帮它出来。

en: I bet this woven thing I've got can float! Here, little rabbit! Hop onto this raft!
cn: 哦！刚才捡到了一个小竹筏！小兔子，来跳到竹筏上吧！

en: Phew! Looks like that bunny is safe and sound now!
cn: 呼！看来小兔子终于安全啦！

en: Back to figuring out what's up with the moon…as long as I can work out which way to go next…
cn: 接下来继续向月亮进发，希望我没走错路。

en: Whoa, so many paper lanterns on the road. Oh I see, the stall's been knocked over! What exactly happened here?
cn: 哇，怎么这些花灯都掉地上了？让我看看……感觉是这个小摊被什么东西撞翻了，这里发生过什么呢？

en: And the lanterns are so pretty—it would be a shame if they got kicked or crushed.
cn: 这些花灯真好看呀，要是弄脏了可太可惜了。

en: Hmm, looks like that rabbit is trying to move them, but it's struggling to even pick them up. I should give them a hand…
cn: 嗯……这只小兔子好像也想把这些灯捡起来，但是对它来说可能是太重了，我去搭把手吧！

en: Wait, did that rabbit say "thank you" just now? Or was I just hearing things?
cn: 等下？刚才那只兔子和我说谢谢了？还是我幻听了？

en: And…actually…how can a rabbit move lanterns around like that in the first place? Why would a rabbit WANT to move a lantern?
cn: 而且……为什么一只兔子会想挪动这些花灯啊！

en: Oh, gosh. Maybe it's better not to think too closely about it.
cn: 老天，我还是不要细想了……

en: Okay. I'm starting to think I'm really lost now. I don't remember there being cliffs like this in Brimwave.
cn: 好吧……我确定自己一定是迷路了……我不记得浪尾岛有这么高的一片山群啊。

en: And um…that is a MASSIVE scroll. The painting is beautiful, but those clouds at the top are DEFINITELY moving.
cn: 好大的卷轴啊……甚至画卷里的山水好像是真的……

en: Well, I should try to get higher up anyway to get a better view of the moon and the way back to Brimwave. Up the mountain it is…
cn: 不过我也确实得去高处看看月亮上什么情况，而且上山了也能找找怎么回去，继续前进吧。

en: Hmm…what do you wanna bet that door will lead me through the mountain? Let's give it a push…
cn: 赌一把吧，希望过了门直接就上山了……一，二，推！

en: The doors are open…this is some sort of portal. And it reveals—
cn: 这个门好像是个传送门，我被传到了哪里？

en: Wow—that view—! But gosh, we're definitely not in Brimwave anymore.
cn: 哇哦，绝景！这肯定不是浪尾岛了！

en: The mist is the same…thick like the fog that rolls into town in the morning but…
cn: 这地方好像有晨雾缭绕……雾蒙蒙的呢。

en: Wow, the moon is so much brighter here…
cn: 而且是错觉吗？月亮好像变得更亮了。

en: Excuse me, traveler, are you headed to the Moon Palace? Can I trouble you to pluck some osmanthus branches for me?
cn: 这位小友，敢问可是前往月宫？可否劳烦为我折几枝桂花来？

en: Oh. The toad is talking now, too—I mean, o-of course I can help you, but I'm not sure what an osmanthus branch looks like.
cn: 绷不住了，怎么蟾蜍都开始说话了？啊，不对，我不是吐槽你，我当然能帮忙，不过桂花枝长什么样子啊？

en: The flowers are small, golden, gleaming—perfect for blessing students in exam season. I would fetch them myself if I had the hands for it.
cn: 此花细碎鎏金，光华灼灼，最适宜为赴考学子送上福运。倘若吾生得双手，便亲自前去采摘了。

en: That's really nice of you to do. Sure, I can look around for some while I get my bearings.
cn: 你人还怪好的。行，我正好趁熟悉周遭环境的时候帮你找找看。

en: Oh, um, you're welcome! Hope the…blessings go well!
cn: 拿去吧，不客气！但愿那些祝福能顺利起效！

en: Earlier the toad said osmanthus grows near the Moon Palace…that must be where I am. Some sort of celestial realm…
cn: 刚才那只蟾蜍说月宫附近就会有桂花？看来我大概是接近月宫了吧，或者是什么古代遗迹。

en: Which makes sense, given the talking toad. And the talking rabbits.
cn: 想想也说得通，毕竟会说话的蟾蜍都出现了，还有那些会说话的兔子。

en: Maybe I really did see a wolf chomping on the moon then…Could the legend of the celestial dog devouring the moon be true?
cn: 难不成我之前看见有野兽啃月亮并不是幻觉？难道天狗吃月亮的传说是真的？

en: Is that someone calling for help? Where is it coming from…? The tree?
cn: 有人在喊救命？从哪里来的声音？树上吗？

en: Another rabbit! Are you stuck up there? I'm all out of bamboo rafts, but I think that wouldn't help here anyway…
cn: 又一只兔子！你怎么卡在上面的？我没有竹筏了，不过那个好像也帮不上忙……
救命！！救命！！我要抓不住了！

en: Oh my gosh, that rabbit is actually speaking— I mean, I knew that they did already, but—
cn: 好家伙，这兔子真的在说话啊！

en: No, that's not important right now, Quinn! D-don't worry, little fella, I'll find something to get you down!
cn: 不对，现在不是在意这个的时候！别担心！小家伙坚持住！我找找有没有什么东西能接住你！

en: Thank the heavens you were here, Miss Mortal Lady!
cn: 谢天谢地多亏了你！谢谢你啊，人类！

en: There I was just minding my busy, busy business when that horrible sky dog ran right at me! I barely escaped up that tree with my life!
cn: 我正忙得脚不沾地，那只吓人的天狗猛地朝我冲过来！我拼了老命才逃到树上！这下真不沾地啦！

en: Then it raced past the tree anyway, off to chew on the moon while our mistress is away, no doubt! Oh dear, what shall we do?!
cn: 结果它压根没理我，一溜烟跑远了！肯定是趁月宫主人不在，跑去啃月亮啦！哎呀呀，这可怎么办！

en: Nothing can be allowed to go wrong with the moon before the Mid-Autumn festivities begin, oh dear, oh dear!
cn: 中秋庆典马上就要开始，月亮可万万不能出岔子啊，糟了糟了！

en: A dog? Not a wolf then…hmm…I wonder if that's what I saw dangling off the moon earlier??
cn: 是小狗？原来不是狼啊…… 嗯，难道我之前看到挂在月亮上的就是它？？
我闻到烟味了！哪儿来的？

en: Fire! Fire! Call for help! Call for help!!!
cn: 着火了！着火了！快来兔啊！救命啊！！！

en: A kitchen fire?! Are there rioters on this mountain too?? But do rabbits even have a fire department to call?!
cn: 厨房起火了？！难道这座山上也有捣乱的家伙？话说兔子这边难道没有消防队可以呼叫吗？！

en: They keep leaping back and forth through the fire, but it's not doing much. Hold on a little longer! I'll look for something to help!
cn: 它们一直在火里窜来窜去，可根本起不了什么作用。再撑一会儿！我去找办法帮忙！

en: Thank the heavens you were here, Miss Mortal Lady! There we were, minding our busy, busy business, making mooncakes for the festival when—
cn: 谢天谢地你来了，人类！我们正忙得团团转，赶着做中秋月饼呢，结果！

en: Let me guess. Was it the sky dog?
cn: 我猜猜，是那只天狗干的？

en: Yes, yes, that celestial beast ran through and knocked over the lamps right into the oil! Headed straight for the Moon, no doubt, oh dear, oh dear!
cn: 对对！那只小家伙冲过来，把灯笼撞翻掉进油里了！肯定是直奔月亮去了，哎呀呀，这下糟了！

en: Lots to do, lots to do, but for your troubles, Miss Mortal, a mooncake, yes, yes—
cn: 事情一大堆！根本忙不过来！不过为了谢谢你出手帮忙，人类，这块月饼送给你！

en: Thank you! It smells great and it tastes…wow! So rich and delicious! I'm even more motivated to keep going forward, thanks!
cn: 谢谢！闻着就很香，吃起来…… 哇！味道丰富又好吃！这下我更有劲头继续赶路了，多谢！

en: Hmm. Is it just me or does it smell strongly of alcohol all of a sudden? It's making me kind of lightheaded and sleepy…
cn: 唔…… 是我的错觉吗，怎么突然一股浓烈的酒气？搞得我头晕乎乎的，还犯困了。

en: The fumes get stronger this way…And no wonder! That's a massive spill up ahead! I feel almost tipsy just facing the bottle…
cn: 往这边走酒味更重了…… 难怪啊！前面洒了好大一片！光是站在酒瓶跟前，我都快要醉了……

en: Oh dear, oh dear— I mean, oh no! What happened to these rabbits on the road? They're passed out right in the puddle of wine!
cn: 哎呀糟了！不对，大事不好！路上这些兔子怎么回事？直接醉倒在酒里了！

en: I better do something about that leaking bottle and the fumes otherwise I won't make it all the way up this mountain either…
cn: 我得想办法堵住漏酒的瓶子，驱散这股酒气，不然我也没法爬上这座山了……
喂，小兔子们！你们还好吗？

en: A mortal lady! Thank the heavens you were *hic* here! T-there we were… mindin' our busy business…
cn: 竟然是个人类！谢天谢地你来了！嗝！我俩……刚才忙……嗝！忙得团团转呢！

en: Was it the sky dog again? Or is it called the celestial dog?
The dog, yes, yes! We were off to find it ourselves, Miss Mortal. The celestial dog is playful and means no harm— only— *hic*
cn: 是它，就是它！我们本来打算自己去找它的，人类姐。那只天界小狗只是贪玩嗝！并没有坏心眼……只不过嗝！

en: Only everyone is looking forward to the full moon tonight. If the dog ruins the moon—
cn: 只不过所有人都盼着今晚的圆月。要是它把月亮搞坏了……

en: Oh dear, oh dear! The mestival— er, the Mid-Autumn festival must go off without a hitch! Will you bring the dog back for us?
cn: 哎呀，这下可糟了！这个佳……呃，中秋节，必须顺顺利利才行！你可以帮我们把那只小狗带回来吗？

en: Here sky doggy! Where did you go— AHA! Right there! Teeth right into the moon just like the rabbits were worried about!
cn: 喂，天狗小家伙！你跑哪儿去了？啊哈！在那儿！果真和兔子们担心的一样，它正死死咬着月亮呢！

en: Wait. That's not the real moon. Unless the moon is actually just an ornament on an impossibly tall tower—
cn: 等等，这并不是真正的月亮。难不成月亮只是一座高耸入云的高塔上的装饰品？

en: No, wait, Quinn, there's the REAL moon right behind it!
cn: 不对不对，奎因，真正的月亮明明就在它身后！

en: Huh. Everytime the dog wiggles, the decorative moon flickers…but then so does the actual moon.
cn: 嗯。小狗每扭动一下，这个月亮摆件就一闪一闪的……  可天上真月亮也跟着一同闪烁。

en: That's…too much for me to think about right now.
cn: 这事儿…… 我现在实在想不明白。

en: What matters is we just gotta get the poor puppy down first. I have a feeling from the whining that it doesn't want to be trapped up there at all.
cn: 眼下最重要的，是先把这可怜的小家伙救下来。听它呜呜的叫声，它肯定是被困在半空中了！

en: How do you catch a celestial dog? By using celestial cushions: clouds! At least…I sure hope this works…
cn: 要怎么接住一只仙界小狗？当然得用仙界软垫：云朵！但愿这法子能管用……

en: Hang tight, puppy! Help is on the way! Don't let go until I say so!
cn: 抓稳咯，小家伙！我来救你了！没我的话千万别松嘴！

en: Phew!! Caught you! Haha, there you go—your tongue is so wet—I know, I know you were probably so scared. You're safe now, little guy.
cn: 呼！可接住你啦！没事咯，哈哈哈你弄得我满脸口水！我懂我懂，你刚刚肯定吓坏了。小家伙，现在安全啦。

en: Now why did you bite the moon in the first place, buddy? Did you mistake it for a giant mooncake?
cn: 话说你当初为啥要去啃那个月亮呀？该不会把它当成巨型月饼了吧？

en: Those sure are yummy, but we're lucky there wasn't any damage and the real moon's all back to normal now.
cn: 月饼确实很香，好在没有造成什么破坏，天上真正的月亮也已经恢复正常了。

en: Hmm, let's get you somewhere where you can't get into too much trouble, and maybe we can snag a few mooncakes for the road too!
cn: 唔，我得把你带到一个不会到处闯祸\n的地方，路上顺便还能再拿几块月饼尝尝！

cn: 清除障碍获得代币，并赢得额外奖励！

cn: 奎因和阿玛拉要享受她们的睡衣派对时光啦！快来帮她们打造一场超完美的睡衣派对吧！

en: Thanks to your help, Quinn and Amala's sleepover was a blast!
cn: 多亏了你的帮忙，奎因和阿玛拉的睡衣派对超级尽兴！

cn: 太棒了！派对所需的睡衣派对好物，你全都集齐啦！

en: There’s more stuff to pick up, but Quinn and Amala can't stay up all night like they used to when they were kids anymore…
cn: 还有更多好物等你来收集，不过奎因和阿玛拉可没法像小时候那样通宵熬夜咯……

en: Let's put together the best sleepover party! Merge items to get the key and unlock the next stage!

cn: 闲旅季已结束，一起期待更精彩的下一季活动吧！

cn: 在闲旅季中升级来获取奖励！

cn: 阿特拉斯给了科尔顿和托尼一个老派奢华的惊喜……

en: Atlas, Colton and Tony nurse food babies after a long lunch…
cn: 一顿狂吃之后，阿特拉斯、科尔顿和托尼撑得走不动路了……

en: Released after an overnight stay, Babette finds that she's not fated to rest…
cn: 熬过一晚终于脱身的芭贝特，却发现自己注定无法安歇……

en: Frankie and Mark discuss their police work priorities…
cn: 弗兰基和马克探讨起各自手头警务的轻重缓急……

en: Babette finds herself in disbelief at her sudden unpopularity…
cn: 芭贝特对自己突然遭到民众厌弃感到难以置信……

cn: 芭贝特和索菲娅收到了一些令人不安的消息……

Atlas continues to wine and dine Colton and Tony through New Cork…
cn: 阿特拉斯继续带着科尔顿和托尼在纽科克狂吃海喝……

en: Frankie arrives at the Marina to check out a reported vandalism…
cn: 弗兰基赶往码头，调查一起蓄意破坏案件……

en: Ramona joins Ziva and Carmen for a relaxing chat on their farm…
cn: 蕾蒙娜来到姬瓦与卡门的农场，享受了一段悠闲的谈心时光……

en: Ziva asks Ramona some important questions…
cn: 姬瓦向蕾蒙娜抛出了几个相当关键的问题……

en: Colton is cornered by Atlas and Tony…
cn: 科尔顿被阿特拉斯和托尼左右夹击，脱不开身……

en: While grabbing a bite to eat, Sophia checks her phone…
cn: 索菲娅在用餐间隙，随手刷起了手机……

en: Quinn helps Olivia with her school homework…
cn: 奎因正在辅导奥利维亚完成学校功课……

en: Harrison leaves a somber voice message for a friend…
cn: 哈里森给朋友留了一段语气沉重的语音……

en: Finally finding the time, Amala calls Harrison back…
cn: 阿玛拉好不容易才腾出空来，给哈里森回了电话……

en: While it's still quiet, Colton plans his great escape…
cn: 趁着四下无人打扰，科尔顿筹划着自己的逃跑大计……

en: Colton meets an unexpected someone at the airport…
cn: 科尔顿在机场见到了一个让他始料未及的人……

en: After a game of phone tag, Harrison and Amala are both free for a call…
cn: 几次漏接电话之后，哈里森和阿玛拉总算通话了……

en: Babette and Sophia prepare for the public forum…
cn: 公开论坛临近，芭贝特和索菲娅做最后的准备……

en: Babette engages with a packed audience at the public forum…
cn: 公开论坛上座无虚席，芭贝特直面岛民……

en: Babette and Sophia convene with Frankie about the forum's success…
cn: 芭贝特和索菲娅与弗兰基碰头，讨论论坛的成果……

en: An old friend is back in town, with a new friend in tow…
cn: 老朋友回城了，还带了个新朋友……

cn: 羊肚菌新星位于银河系一隅的紫色星域。宇航员奥利维亚、山姆和诺曼正前往探索这颗外星星球，结交朋友！与他们一起漫游星海，探索羊肚菌新星吧！

en: Well then, it looks like our outpost supplies have depleted. That was a fun venture, make sure to catch the next planet tour!
cn: 好了，看来前哨站的补给已经耗尽。这是一次充满乐趣的探险，千万别错过下一次的星球之旅哦！

en: Were you able to catch the UFO flying lessons? Maybe there's still time before they all fly to a galaxy far, far away…
cn: 你赶上飞碟飞行课了吗？趁它们还没飞往遥远的星系，也许还有时间……

en: Hoorah! There's time for one more dip in the crater pool! You have 2 more days to complete the event.
cn: 万岁！还有时间去陨石坑水池里再泡个澡！你还有两天时间完成活动哦。

cn: 收集飞碟，获取额外的活动积分吧！

en: Wahoo! You've collected all of the UFOs! Now, how about an adventure on the space rover!
cn: 哇哦！你已经收集了所有飞碟！现在，开上太空漫游车去探险怎么样？

en: Hmm, perhaps that's enough for now. It's time to catch the shuttle back home.
cn: 嗯，这次就先到这里吧。是时候搭乘航天飞机回家了。

cn: 赚取活动积分提升排名，并获得丰厚奖励!

en: Collect<sprite="icon_decoration_2" name="icon_decoration_2"> {0} to join Supernova Swoop!
cn: 获取<sprite="icon_decoration_2" name="icon_decoration_2">{0} 后加入排行榜

en: Collect event tokens and we can play in Supernova Swoop! C'mon let's play!
cn: 收集活动积分来参与超新星疾冲！让我们一起来玩吧！

en: Ah man. Supernova Swoop is over! Let's wait to see the final scores!
cn: 啊欧，超新星疾冲结束了！稍等片刻，再来看最终结果吧！
你在超新星疾冲中获得了第<color=#fff33a><size=60>{0}</size></color>名

en: Tony’s helping with rainforest conservation! Head over to help clear invasive trees and boost native regrowth!
cn: 托尼正在努力保护雨林生态！快来帮忙清除入侵树木，促进本土植物生长吧！

en: Complete orders to earn <sprite="icon_farm2_tool" name="icon_farm2_tool">, then tap the tree to collect wood and merge them on the board.
cn: 完成订单以获取 <sprite="icon_farm2_tool" name="icon_farm2_tool">，随后点击树木收集木材，并在棋盘上合成它们。

en: Earn <sprite="icon_farm2_byprod" name="icon_farm2_byprod"> by trading nuts with the squirrel! Keep merging them to win more rewards!
cn: 通过和松鼠交换坚果获取 <sprite="icon_farm2_byprod" name="icon_farm2_byprod">，持续合成它们可赢得更多奖励！

en: Tony’s carved some cute commemorative animals from the leftover wood! Continue exploring the board to earn more rewards!
cn: 托尼用剩下的木头雕刻了一些可爱的纪念小动物！继续探索棋盘，获取更多奖励。

en: Not only does Tony feel great after volunteering, but he also made some adorable charms to give to friends! Win-win!
cn: 这次志愿活动不仅让托尼成就感满满，他还做了可爱的小挂饰送给朋友，简直是两全其美！

en: It’s been a good effort, but the sun’s already setting on today’s volunteer operation. Tony’ll be back to help again soon!
cn: 今天收获颇丰，但太阳已经落山，志愿行动暂告一段落。托尼很快就会回来继续出力！

en: Looks like we found an invasive tree marked for removal. Tap to use an axe to cut it down and collect wood.
cn: 发现一棵标注待清理的入侵树种，点击使用斧头砍伐并获取木材。

en: Wow! We shook down some nuts! Tap the squirrel to see what happens next!
cn: 哇！摇落了不少坚果！点击松鼠看看接下来会发生什么！

en: We received a rattan ball! Keep tapping the squirrel to get more!
cn: 我们获得了藤球！继续点击松鼠获取更多藤球！

en: Tap the plot to plant the seedling in Tony’s volunteer site. We now have a new tree!
cn: 点击将树苗栽种到托尼的志愿场地中，即可获得一颗新的树木。

en: Remember: each tree can only yield one piece of wood, but each axe can cut from many trees!
cn: 小贴士：每棵树仅能产出 一 份木材，但一把斧头可以砍伐多棵树！

en: Wait! Tap the squirrel to finish receiving your gift!
cn: 等等！点击松鼠领完你的奖励再走！

en: Search for more marked trees to add to your site!
cn: 寻找更多标注好的树木，添加到你的场地中！

en: Complete orders to earn axes and use them to collect wood from the invasive trees.
cn: 完成订单获取斧头，砍伐入侵树种收集木材。

en: Merge wood to earn keys and unlock clouds. Tap the squirrel to trade nuts for rattan balls.
cn: 合成木制品获得钥匙，解锁云层覆盖区域；点击松鼠，用坚果兑换藤球。

en: Merge rattan items to earn bigger rewards!
cn: 合成藤编道具，赢取更重磅的奖励！

en: These areas are covered by clouds, but we can unlock them later.
cn: 这些区域被云层覆盖。但我们稍后可以解锁。

en: Merge items to a higher level, then we can get a key to unlock more spaces on the board!
cn: 将物品合成到更高等级，我们就可以获得一把钥匙来解锁棋盘上的更多空间。

en: Collect gems to unveil a mystery reward!
cn: 收集宝石，解锁神秘奖励!

en: You pulled back the curtain and revealed a valuable treasure chest!
cn: 你拉开帷幕并揭晓了神秘大奖!

en: Celebrate all things creepy, crawly, and sometimes cute by completing a new Halloween Card Collection!
cn: 那些可爱又可怖的小东西就藏在卡牌中，集齐卡组，释放它们的力量！

en: Tony’s trying out an all-in-one cauldron to infuse his dishes with spooky seasonal flavors. Let’s help him try out new Halloween recipes!
cn: 托尼弄来了一口全能的魔法大锅，要给他的菜肴添上几分万圣节的诡异风味。一起帮他试试新的万圣节食谱吧！

en: Complete orders to earn <sprite="icon_farm3_tool" name="icon_farm3_tool">, then tap the Cauldron to collect Monstrous Morsels and merge them.
cn: 完成订单即可获得 <sprite="icon_farm3_tool" name="icon_farm3_tool">，然后点击魔锅收集惊奇美食，并在棋盘上进行合并。

en: Earn <sprite="icon_farm3_byprod" name="icon_farm3_byprod"> by trading Magical Manuscripts with the Kitty Kitchen Witch. Keep merging them to win more rewards!
cn: 合成魔法手稿给猫猫大厨，即可获得 <sprite="icon_farm3_byprod" name="icon_farm3_byprod">。不断合并，赢取更多奖励！

en: Great work, chef! Continue your creepy culinary adventure to earn more rewards!
cn: 干得漂亮，大厨！继续这趟毛骨悚然的美食冒险，赢取更多奖励吧！

en: Tony's cauldron cooking created mouthwatering monstrous morsels and drew plenty of ghostly helping hands to the kitchen!
cn: 托尼用魔法大锅做出了令人垂涎的惊奇美食，还召唤了一大群幽灵帮手进厨房！

en: The cauldron's still bubbling away, but Tony can watch the pot on his own. Time to leave the heat of the kitchen and take a break!
cn: 魔锅还在咕嘟咕嘟地冒泡，不过托尼一个人看锅就够了。是时候离开热气腾腾的厨房，好好歇一歇了！

en: A new disturbing dish is finished! Tap to gather finished freaky foods from the cauldron!
cn: 又有新的诡异佳肴出锅啦！点击即可从魔锅中收取做好的惊奇美食！

en: It's a Magical Manuscript! I'm sure the Kitty Kitchen Witch will appreciate the gift—tap on them to see what happens next!
cn: 是魔法手稿！猫猫大厨肯定喜欢这份礼物——点击它，看看接下来会发生什么！

en: The Kitty Kitchen Witch summoned some ghosts to help with cooking! Keep tapping the cat to summon more!
cn: 猫猫大厨召唤出了一些幽灵来帮忙做菜！继续点击猫咪，召唤更多帮手！

en: Tap to add more cauldrons to the fire and speed up making eerie entrees and terrifying treats!
cn: 点击把更多魔锅放上灶台，加快制作惊奇美食的速度！

en: Remember, each cauldron produces one Monstrous Morsel, and each ladle can collect dishes from multiple cauldrons!
cn: 记住：每口魔锅只产出一份惊奇美食，但一把勺子可以同时从多口魔锅中收取菜品！

en: Wait! Tap on the Kitchen Witch to finish summoning first!
cn: 等一下！先点击猫猫大厨，完成召唤吧！

en: Find more tiny cauldrons to make more dishes!
cn: 找到更多小魔锅，做出更多菜品！

en: Complete orders to earn ladles and use them to collect dishes from the cauldrons.
cn: 完成订单可获得勺子，用它从魔锅中收取菜品。

en: Merge Monstrous Morsels to earn keys to unlock covered areas. Tap the Kitty Kitchen Witch to trade Magical Manuscripts for Haunted Cookware.
cn: 合并惊奇美食可获得钥匙，用来解锁被遮盖的区域。点击猫猫大厨，用魔法手稿换取闹鬼厨具。

en: Merge Haunted Cookware for even bigger rewards!
cn: 合并闹鬼厨具，赢取更丰厚的奖励！

en: These areas are covered by clouds, but we can unlock them later.
cn: 这些区域被云层覆盖。但我们稍后可以解锁。

en: Merge items to a higher level, then we can get a key to unlock more spaces on the board!
cn: 将物品合成到更高等级，我们就可以获得一把钥匙来解锁棋盘上的更多空间。

en: Collect gems to unveil a mystery reward!
cn: 收集宝石，解锁神秘奖励!

en: You pulled back the curtain and revealed a valuable treasure chest!
cn: 你拉开帷幕并揭晓了神秘大奖!

en: Oh dear, what to do with all this extra yarn? Help Imelda untangle the skeins so she can crochet handmade gifts for friends!
cn: 哦亲爱的，我们这里有这么多毛线！快帮伊梅尔达用这些毛线钩织可爱的礼物送给朋友们吧！

en: Thanks to your help, Imelda crafted some lovely crochet gifts for her friends!
cn: 多亏了你的帮忙。伊梅尔达为朋友们精心制作了好几份可爱的钩织礼物！

en: Nice one! Imelda made her way through the yarn and even started her own crochet club!
cn: 太棒了！伊梅尔达搞定了所有毛线，甚至创办了自己的钩织俱乐部！

en: Oh no! There’s still so much yarn left, but not enough hours in the day. Time to tie up the loose ends…
cn: 哦不！还剩一大堆毛线，可今天的时间不够用了，先把它们草草处理一下吧……

en: Grab your hooks and yarn! Merge items to get the key and unlock the next stage.
cn: 开启你的钩织之旅！合并物品以获取钥匙，解锁下一阶段。

en: Tap here to add items to the board, then merge them!
cn: 点击这里将物品添加到棋盘，并合成它们！

en: You've unlocked the next stage! Tap to enter.
cn: 你已经解锁了下一阶段！点击前往吧。

en: Merge items to earn the key to the next stage.
cn: 合成物品获得钥匙并开门解锁下一阶段

en: Explore all the stages and win big prizes!
cn: 探索全部阶段棋盘获得大奖

en: Merge items to get the key and unlock the next stage!
cn: 获得指定物品可得到钥匙开门，进入下一阶段

en: If you choose to go to the next stage, the remaining rewards on this board will be collected automatically.
cn: 如果您选择进入下一阶段，此棋盘上的奖励将被自动收集

en: All event items on the current board will be transferred to the next stage.
cn: 已获得的棋子将被带入下一阶段

en: You need a key! Merge items to get one.
cn: 你需要一把钥匙！合成物品来获得它。

en: Collect gems to unveil a mystery reward!
cn: 收集宝石，解锁神秘奖励!

en: You pulled back the curtain and revealed a valuable treasure chest!
cn: 你拉开帷幕并揭晓了神秘大奖!

en: Heidi gently checks in with Harrison…
cn: 海蒂温柔地问起哈里森的情况……

en: Harrison musters his physical and mental strength…
cn: 哈里森终于鼓起勇气，迈出艰难一步……

en: Newly arrived in paradise, Tony and Atlas lounge about…
cn: 刚到人间天堂，托尼和阿特拉斯便尽情享受起来……

en: Harrison and Heidi take a leisurely stroll…
cn: 哈里森和海蒂在镇上慢慢散步……

en: Out and about on her own, Heidi enjoys a tasty breakfast…
cn: 独自出门的海蒂，悠闲享用起美味早餐……

en: Frankie sets out to make sure she gets the information she wants…
cn: 为了拿到想要的情报，弗兰基决定亲自出马……

en: Harrison and Lloyd share tales of watery wisdom…
cn: 哈里森和劳埃德聊起大海带来的慰藉……

en: Frankie finally reaches the end of her tether…
cn: 弗兰基的耐心终于彻底耗尽……

en: Heidi arrives to meet with Harrison, only to find him crying…
cn: 海蒂前来找哈里森，却撞见他泪流满面……

en: Tony and Atlas recover after a wild celebrity party…
cn: 疯狂派对过后，托尼和阿特拉斯艰难“复活”……

en: Heidi continues riding the enthusiasm of being in Brimwave…
cn: 海蒂仍沉浸在身处浪尾岛的兴奋中……

en: With Bruno and Frankie on the phone, Babette prepares herself…
cn: 布鲁诺和弗兰基已在电话另一头，芭贝特深吸一口气……

en: After hours of false leads and dead ends, Babette starts to fray…
cn: 搜索了几个小时仍毫无进展，芭贝特渐渐濒临崩溃……

en: Babette makes an important call to Imelda…
cn: 芭贝特给伊梅尔达打了一通事关重大的电话……

en: Harrison and Heidi discuss the art of letting go…
cn: 哈里森和海蒂谈起该如何放下……

en: While out and about, Harrison receives a text from his fellow Musketeer…
cn: 外出途中，哈里森收到了三剑客伙伴的消息……

en: Norman keeps Imelda company on the phone as she hikes inland…
cn: 伊梅尔达向岛内徒步进发，诺曼则一直通过电话陪伴着她……

en: Imelda stumbles across a surprising fellow visitor…
cn: 伊梅尔达意外遇见了一个人……

en: Imelda helps a helpless Crane back down the hiking trail…
cn: 伊梅尔达扶着束手无策的克雷恩走下步道……

en: Two sea dogs try to take in the calming waters…
cn: 两位老水手望着海面谈心……

en: Frankie awaits word from Babette, readying herself to face Bruno…
cn: 弗兰基等待芭贝特的答复，做好了直面布鲁诺的准备……

en: The Three Musketeers and their partners meet for date night…
cn: 铁三角携各自伴侣齐聚约会之夜……

en: After a few awkward icebreakers, the big date night continues…
cn: 几轮尴尬的破冰过后，盛大的约会之夜仍在继续……

en: After returning from date night, Heidi pulls Quinn aside…
cn: 约会归来后，海蒂把奎因拉到一旁……

en: Coconut's been catnapped by bats! Help Olivia save him from the old castle!
cn: 小椰子被蝙蝠绑架了！帮奥利维亚把他从危机重重的古堡里救出来！

en: Explore the depths of the castle
Olivia rescued Coconut from the castle! It's time to go home and enjoy the rest of the Halloween festivities!
cn: 奥利维亚救出了小椰子！是时候回家向大家展示他们的万圣节服装啦！

en: Olivia got too scared! Luckily, Coconut made his own daring escape. Now let's get out of the spooky castle!
cn: 奥利维亚害怕得走不动路，不过勇敢的小椰子自己逃出来和她汇合了！一起回家吧！

en: The bats are gone and Coconut is safe! Time to explore a bit more while Count Coconut naps.
cn: 太好啦！蝙蝠们都逃走啦！小椰子累得想打盹，我们趁他睡觉继续在古堡中探索吧！

en: Use Energy to complete tasks and get closer to our mission objective!
cn: 消耗体力清除路上的障碍!

en: \nMission Control will update key tasks to help us complete our mission!
cn: 任务中心会发布关键任务帮我们更快找到回家路!

en: Let's do our best to find the target location!
cn: 试试定位到任务目的地吧!

en: We've got a special backpack for all the cool stuff we find! Tap to open it.
cn: 我们采集到了一些物品，打开背包看看都有什么。

en: Tap here to release the items – then we can merge them to earn rewards!
cn: 点击这里将物品释放出来，合并物品解锁惊喜奖励！

en: Let's push forward and explore once we're all rested up!
cn: 休息好了就抓紧向前探索吧!

en: If we get lost, we can look at Mission Control to figure out what to do!
cn: 迷路的时候不妨看看“任务中心”寻找方向!

en: There seems to be a door up ahead. Let's go check it out.
cn: 前面好像有个枯木门，快去探索一番吧！

en: Where can I find a key to open the door?
cn: 哪里能找到打开大门的钥匙呢？

en: You found the invisibility cloak and the wand—now you can sneak past the ghost!
cn: 找到了隐身衣和魔法棒，可以从幽灵旁边溜走啦！

en: Oh no! How can you make your way through the room when you can't see your hand in front of your face!? It's too dark!
cn: 怎样才能穿越伸手不见五指的房间呢？

en: Is that Coconut meowing? Go check it out!
cn: 是小椰子在喵喵叫吗？快去看看！

en: Jeepers! Coconut is surrounded by bats! Quick, find a way to chase them away!
cn: 小椰子被蝙蝠包围了！快想办法赶走蝙蝠！

en: Wake up the sleeping pumpkin cat
Earn tokens from clearing obstacles and earn extra rewards!
cn: 清除障碍获得代币，并赢得额外奖励！

en: Earn tokens by using event energy to clear obstacles!
cn: 消耗活动体力清除障碍来获得代币！

en: Looking fangtastic Count Coconut! Like a vampire for realsies!
cn: 尊贵的小椰子伯爵，你这身打扮真是了不起！简直就是吸血鬼降临！

en: Mraaaw! (You make a cool werewolf, but a wereCAT would've been better.)
cn: 喵嗷！（你扮的狼人也不赖，不过我觉得你更应该试试狼猫哈哈。）

en: Now it's time for a proper Halloween monster fight! Grr!! Take that my sworn enemy!
cn: 现在该来一场真正的万圣节怪物大战了！嗷呜！！接招吧，我的宿敌！

en: Meeew. Ek ek ek. (Alright alright, but be gentle with those claws. Hmm...did you hear that?)
cn: 咪呜。喵喵喵。（那就接招吧！可别把你的爪子玩坏啦！诶？什么声音……你听见了吗？）

en: Noo! Coconut! Come back with my cat, you stupid bats!
cn: 回来！小椰子！你们这些臭蝙蝠，把我的猫还回来！

en: But where are they taking him?
cn: 可是它们要把他带到哪里去？

en: Huh…it looks like they’re going to that real spooky castle over there…
cn: 咦……它们好像正飞向那边那座超级吓人的城堡……

en: Oh boy. And it looks like I’ll have to go through that doubly spooky garden to get to him.
cn: 天哪。看来要找到他，我还得穿过那片加倍吓人的花园。

en: Oh, it’s glue. But now’s not the time for arts and crafts. I gotta save Coconut!
cn: 哦，是胶水。可现在不是做手工的时候。我得去救小椰子！

en: But maybe I should keep it, just in case.
cn: 不过以防万一，还是先拿着吧！

en: You never know what could need gluing later!
cn: 谁知道之后会不会有什么东西需要粘起来呢！

en: Ahhh…A broken skeleton…how did he get all broken like that? Does he need help?
cn: 咦？是个散架的骷髅，他怎么会碎成这样？诶诶？需要帮忙吗？

en: The glue! I can glue his bones back together!
cn: 胶水！我可以把他的骨头粘回去！

en: Hold on, Skelly – I’ll fix you up. Just don’t be super scary, okay?
cn: 等一下，小骷髅——我来帮你修好。只要你别突然跳起来吓我，好吗？

en: TA-DA! You’re all back to normal!
cn: 锵锵！你完全恢复正常啦！

en: Now be careful, Skelly, don’t go off breaking your bones again!
cn: 以后要小心哦，小骷髅，可别再把自己的骨头弄断啦！

en: That's a great song! Have fun!
Oh, and if you do break your bones, I have more glue to help!
cn: 哦对了，要是你的骨头又断了，我还有胶水可以帮忙！

en: Eww, look at all the spiderwebs!
cn: 噫，怎么这么多蜘蛛网啊！

en: I'm a werewolf today, but I still don’t like spiders that much.
cn: 虽然我今天是狼人，可我还是害怕蜘蛛啊啊啊。

en: I need to get rid of them. But with what…?
cn: 我得把这些蜘蛛网清掉。可是用什么呢？

en: Blech! All done! But what’s that spooky glow…?
cn: 呕！全都清理干净了！可那道阴森森的光是什么？

en: It's a castle! But why is it super teensy and see-through?
cn: 是一座城堡！可它为什么这么小，还是透明的？

en: Wait it looks just like that castle I saw from far away!
cn: 等等，它看起来就跟我从远处看到的那座城堡一模一样！

en: Now I’m super-duper sure that’s where Coconut is! I’m on my way!
cn: 现在我百分之百确定，小椰子就在那里！我来啦！

en: Huh? It looks like that big stone door moved…
cn: 咦？那个大石板好像动了……

en: And it sounds like something’s COMING OUT!
cn: 而且听起来，有什么东西要出来了！

en: What do I do? What do I do? The door, I have to close the door!
cn: 怎么办？怎么办？石板！我得把石板合上！

en: Phew. I got the door closed!
Good! ‘Cause I don’t think I was ready to fight a zombie.
cn: 松一口气！我还没准备好大战僵尸呢。

en: Would it be a zombie? Or a different monster?
cn: 出来的会是僵尸吗？还是别的怪物？

en: I shouldn’t stick around to find out. I need to find Coconut!
cn: 我不该现在纠结这些，赶紧继续出发找小椰子吧！

en: A zombie! Did it see me? I hope not…
cn: 有僵尸！它看到我了吗？希望没有……

en: I can’t let it get me. ‘Cause I’m not gonna be a zombie! Nuh-uh!
cn: 我可不能被它抓住。因为我才不要被吃脑子！绝对不要！

en: How can I get past it…?
HA HA! I knew the banana peel trick would work!
cn: 哈哈！我就知道香蕉皮这招有用！
僵尸拜拜！小椰子，我来啦！

en: Well, not yet, but soon! Hopefully, the castle is close…
cn: 虽然还没找到城堡，不过快了！希望城堡就在附近……

en: But the doors won’t open! Give me back my Coconut!
cn: 可是门打不开！快把我的小椰子还给我！

en: A key. There has to be a key somewhere.
cn: 钥匙。附近肯定有一把钥匙。

en: Abracadabra! The gates are open. Hmmm…
cn: 天灵灵地灵灵！大门打开啦。嗯……

en: This castle’s not so big and scary after all.
cn: 这座城堡好像不过如此嘛，没看起来那么吓人。

en: The bats! It's probably filled with vampires!
cn: 是蝙蝠！这里肯定到处都是吸血鬼！

en: Maybe it IS a little scary…the stairs are broken too, oh no...
cn: 不得不承认确实有一点吓人……楼梯也坏了，糟糕……

en: WoOoOo! Hello, little girl. Welcome to—
cn: 呜呜呜！小姑娘，你好。欢迎来到——

en: Yes, I am a ghost. And you shall go no further. Your cat is OURS.
cn: 说我是鬼倒也没什么问题。不过你休想再往前一步。你的猫是我们的了。

en: Psh, yeah right! I’m getting Coconut back! And you can't stop me!
cn: 才怪！我一定要把小椰子救回来！你拦不住我！

en: But how do I get past that mean old ghost? These are the only stairs up.
cn: 可我要怎么绕过那个讨厌的老鬼魂呢？这里就只有这条楼梯能上去。

en: Hmm, maybe an invisibility cloak and a wand would help…
cn: 嗯，也许隐形斗篷和魔杖能帮上忙……

en: Hah. That silly ghost can’t see me now!
cn: 哈。那个傻幽灵现在看不见我啦！

en: Where did that little girl go? It’s like she’s gone…invisible.
cn: 那个小姑娘去哪儿了？她好像……隐形了。

en: Now I can go find Coconut!
cn: 现在我可以去找小椰子啦！

en: Where did the path go!? It’s all dark, and I can’t see.
cn: 路去哪儿了？！这里黑漆漆的，我什么都看不见。

en: It feels dangerous to keep going if I can't see…
cn: 什么都看不见的话，继续往前走好像很危险……

en: But I need to get Coconut. I have to find a way through.
cn: 但我不能放弃小椰子。我必须想办法穿过去。

en: This’ll help! I can go night vision!
cn: 这个能派上用场！我可以开启夜视模式！

en: Whoa! Everything looks all cool and green!
cn: 哇！所有东西都变得绿绿的，好酷！

en: This'll help me find Coconut in this spooky old castle!
cn: 这下我就能在这座阴森森的古堡里找到小椰子了！

en: Hopefully I’m getting close to Coconut…
cn: 希望我快要找到小椰子了……

en: Why do castles have to be so spooky and big!? How many rooms do ghosts and monsters need?
cn: 城堡为什么非得这么阴森、这么大啊？！幽灵和怪物到底需要多少个房间？

en: I guess I’ll find out tonight…
cn: 看来今晚我就会知道了……

en: COCONUT! I finally found you. Do you know how many rooms there are!?
cn: 小椰子！我终于找到你了。你知道这里有多少个房间吗？！

en: Mraaaw! (Waah! Get me out of here!)
cn: 喵嗷！呜哇！（呜呜呜，别说这个了，快带我离开这里！）

en: Prrrrt. Meww. (I’m scared and these bats are a little TOO friendly!)
cn: 呼噜噜。喵呜。（人家好害怕，而且这些蝙蝠也热情得有点过头了！）

en: MOWWWW! (So please, hurry up and SAVE ME!)
cn: 喵嗷——！（所以拜托了，快点救我！）

en: Coconut! Did those bats hurt you at all?
cn: 小椰子！那些蝙蝠有没有伤到你？

en: Meeeew. (Nope! They thought I was Count Dracula!)
cn: 喵呜。（没有！它们以为我是德库拉伯爵！）

en: Hah! I did a great job on your costume, but bats do have bad eyesight. That’s why I used the flashlight!
cn: 哈！看来我给你做的服装棒极了，不过蝙蝠的视力确实很差。这就是为什么我刚才用手电筒晃它们的眼睛！

en: Meeew. Prrt. (You’re such a smart little human.)
cn: 喵呜。呼噜。（你这个小人类可真聪明。）

en: Mreeeowww. (But whew, I could use a good cat nap. I'm so...sleepy...suddenly.)
cn: 喵嗷——。（不过，呼，我得好好睡个猫觉了。我突然……好困……）

en: Don't worry Count Coconut! You take your nap and I'll keep an eye out for any stray bats! Grr!!
cn: 别担心，小椰子伯爵！你安心睡吧，我会留意有没有落单的蝙蝠！嗷呜！！

en: Mraaaw. Prrt. (Can always count on sworn monster enemies to have your back...)
cn: 喵嗷。呼噜噜噜。（有个不离不弃的怪物宿敌罩着，果然让喵放心……）

en: What a find – a treasure chest encased in crystal! Let's retrieve the prize!
cn: 惊喜发现！是一颗包裹宝藏的晶石，试试敲碎它吧！

en: Collect points to crack the crystal!
cn: 尽快收集积分击碎晶石吧！

en: Babette and Frankie try to see the brighter side of things…
cn: 巴贝特和弗兰基试着把事情往好处想……

cn: 伊梅尔达和诺曼收看电视节目，找点乐子……

cn: 弗兰基和市长应付着这位不速之客……

cn: 与克雷恩之间这场古怪的对峙仍在继续……
